   244→) -> None:
   245→    """Set or clear a note on a finding."""
   246→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   247→    now = utc_now()
   248→    overrides = plan["overrides"]
   249→    if finding_id not in overrides:
   250→        overrides[finding_id] = {"finding_id": finding_id, "created_at": now}
   251→    overrides[finding_id]["note"] = note
   252→    overrides[finding_id]["updated_at"] = now
   253→
   254→
   255→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   256→# Clusters
   257→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   258→
   259→def create_cluster(
   260→    plan: PlanModel,
   261→    name: str,
   262→    description: str | None = None,
   263→    action: str | None = None,
   264→) -> Cluster:
   265→    """Create a named cluster. Raises ValueError if it already exists."""
   266→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   267→    if name.startswith("auto/"):
   268→        raise ValueError(
   269→            f"Cluster names starting with 'auto/' are reserved for auto-clusters: {name!r}"
   270→        )
   271→    if name.startswith("epic/"):
   272→        raise ValueError(
   273→            f"Cluster names starting with 'epic/' are reserved for synthesis epics: {name!r}"
   274→        )
   275→    if name in plan["clusters"]:
   276→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} already exists")
   277→    now = utc_now()
   278→    cluster: Cluster = {
   279→        "name": name,
   280→        "description": description,
   281→        "finding_ids": [],
   282→        "created_at": now,
   283→        "updated_at": now,
   284→        "auto": False,
   285→        "cluster_key": "",
   286→        "action": action,
   287→        "user_modified": False,
   288→    }
   289→    plan["clusters"][name] = cluster
   290→    return cluster
   291→
   292→
   293→def add_to_cluster(
   294→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str]
   295→) -> int:
   296→    """Add finding IDs to a cluster. Returns count added."""
   297→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   298→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   299→    if cluster is None:
   300→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   301→
   302→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["finding_ids"]
   303→    count = 0
   304→    now = utc_now()
   305→    for fid in finding_ids:
   306→        if fid not in member_ids:
   307→            member_ids.append(fid)
   308→            count += 1
   309→        # Update override to track cluster membership
   310→        overrides = plan["overrides"]
   311→        if fid not in overrides:
   312→            overrides[fid] = {"finding_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   313→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = cluster_name
   314→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   315→
   316→    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   317→    return count
   318→
   319→
   320→def remove_from_cluster(
   321→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str]
   322→) -> int:
   323→    """Remove finding IDs from a cluster. Returns count removed."""
   324→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   325→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   326→    if cluster is None:
   327→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   328→
   329→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["finding_ids"]
   330→    now = utc_now()
   331→    count = 0
   332→    for fid in finding_ids:
   333→        if fid in member_ids:
   334→            member_ids.remove(fid)
   335→            count += 1
   336→        # Clear cluster from override
   337→        override = plan["overrides"].get(fid)
   338→        if override and override.get("cluster") == cluster_name:
   339→            override["cluster"] = None
   340→            override["updated_at"] = now
   341→
   342→    # Mark auto-clusters as user_modified when items are manually removed
   343→    if count > 0 and cluster.get("auto"):
   344→        cluster["user_modified"] = True
   345→
   346→    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   347→    return count
   348→
   349→
   350→def delete_cluster(plan: PlanModel, name: str) -> list[str]:
   351→    """Delete a cluster and clear cluster refs from overrides. Returns orphaned IDs."""
   352→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   353→    cluster = plan["clusters"].pop(name, None)
   354→    if cluster is None:
   355→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} does not exist")
   356→
   357→    orphaned = list(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   358→    now = utc_now()
   359→    for fid in orphaned:
   360→        override = plan["overrides"].get(fid)
   361→        if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
   362→            override["cluster"] = None
   363→            override["updated_at"] = now
   364→
   365→    if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
   366→        plan["active_cluster"] = None
   367→
   368→    return orphaned
   369→
   370→
   371→def move_cluster(
   372→    plan: PlanModel,
   373→    cluster_name: str,
   374→    position: str,
   375→    target: str | None = None,
   376→    offset: int | None = None,
   377→) -> int:
   378→    """Move all cluster members as a contiguous block. Returns count moved."""
   379→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   380→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   381→    if cluster is None:
   382→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   383→
   384→    member_ids = list(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   385→    if not member_ids:
   386→        return 0
   387→
   388→    return move_items(plan, member_ids, position, target, offset)
   389→
   390→
   391→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   392→# Focus
   393→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   394→
   395→def set_focus(plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str) -> None:
   396→    """Set the active cluster focus."""
   397→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   398→    if cluster_name not in plan["clusters"]:
   399→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   400→    plan["active_cluster"] = cluster_name
   401→
   402→
   403→def clear_focus(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
   404→    """Clear the active cluster focus."""
   405→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   406→    plan["active_cluster"] = None
   407→
   408→
   409→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   410→# Reset
   411→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   412→
   413→def reset_plan(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
   414→    """Reset plan to empty state, preserving version and created timestamp."""
   415→    created = plan.get("created", utc_now())
   416→    plan.clear()
   417→    for k, v in empty_plan().items():
   418→        plan[k] = v
   419→    plan["created"] = created
   420→
   421→
   422→def purge_ids(plan: PlanModel, finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
   423→    """Remove finding IDs from the plan entirely.
   424→
   425→    Cleans queue_order, skipped, and all cluster memberships.
   426→    Does NOT touch overrides (descriptions/notes are kept for history).
   427→    Returns count of IDs that were actually present somewhere.
   428→    """
   429→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   430→    found = 0
   431→
   432→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   433→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   434→    for fid in finding_ids:
   435→        was_present = False
   436→        if fid in order:
   437→            order.remove(fid)
   438→            was_present = True
   439→        if fid in skipped:
   440→            skipped.pop(fid)
   441→            was_present = True
   442→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   443→            ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   444→            if fid in ids:
   445→                ids.remove(fid)
   446→                was_present = True
   447→        if was_present:
   448→            found += 1
   449→
   450→    return found
   451→

    22→}
    23→
    24→NO_COLOR = os.environ.get("NO_COLOR") is not None
    25→
    26→
    27→def colorize(text: str, color: str) -> str:
    28→    if NO_COLOR or not sys.stdout.isatty():
    29→        return str(text)
    30→    return f"{COLORS.get(color, '')}{text}{COLORS['reset']}"
    31→
    32→
    33→def log(msg: str) -> None:
    34→    """Print a dim status message to stderr."""
    35→    print(colorize(msg, "dim"), file=sys.stderr)
    36→
    37→
    38→def print_table(
    39→    headers: list[str], rows: list[list[str]], widths: list[int] | None = None
    40→) -> None:
    41→    if not rows:
    42→        return
    43→    if not widths:
    44→        widths = [
    45→            max(len(str(h)), *(len(str(r[i])) for r in rows))
    46→            for i, h in enumerate(headers)
    47→        ]
    48→    header_line = "  ".join(h.ljust(w) for h, w in zip(headers, widths, strict=False))
    49→    print(colorize(header_line, "bold"))
    50→    print(colorize("─" * (sum(widths) + 2 * (len(widths) - 1)), "dim"))
    51→    for row in rows:
    52→        print("  ".join(str(v).ljust(w) for v, w in zip(row, widths, strict=False)))
    53→
    54→
    55→def display_entries(
    56→    args: object,
    57→    entries: Sequence[Any],
    58→    *,
    59→    label: str,
    60→    empty_msg: str,
    61→    columns: Sequence[str],
    62→    widths: list[int] | None,
    63→    row_fn: Callable[[Any], list[str]],
    64→    json_payload: dict | None = None,
    65→    overflow: bool = True,
    66→) -> bool:
    67→    """Standard JSON/empty/table display for detect commands."""
    68→    if getattr(args, "json", False):
    69→        payload = json_payload or {"count": len(entries), "entries": entries}
    70→        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
    71→        return True
    72→    if not entries:
    73→        print(colorize(empty_msg, "green"))
    74→        return False
    75→    print(colorize(f"\n{label}: {len(entries)}\n", "bold"))
    76→    top = getattr(args, "top", 20)
    77→    rows = [row_fn(e) for e in entries[:top]]
    78→    print_table(list(columns), rows, widths)
    79→    if overflow and len(entries) > top:
    80→        print(f"\n  ... and {len(entries) - top} more")
    81→    return True
    82→
    83→
    84→__all__ = [
    85→    "LOC_COMPACT_THRESHOLD",
    86→    "COLORS",
    87→    "NO_COLOR",
    88→    "colorize",
    89→    "display_entries",
    90→    "log",
    91→    "print_table",
    92→]
    93→

    24→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    25→# Backward-compatible test patch hook; runtime path resolution uses get_project_root().
    26→PROJECT_ROOT = get_project_root()
    27→_PROJECT_ROOT_SENTINEL = PROJECT_ROOT
    28→
    29→
    30→def _get_detector_names() -> list[str]:
    31→    """Return cached detector names, computing on first access."""
    32→    global _DETECTOR_NAMES
    33→    if _DETECTOR_NAMES is None:
    34→        _DETECTOR_NAMES = detector_names()
    35→    return _DETECTOR_NAMES
    36→
    37→
    38→def _invalidate_detector_names_cache() -> None:
    39→    """Invalidate detector-name cache when runtime registrations change."""
    40→    global _DETECTOR_NAMES
    41→    _DETECTOR_NAMES = None
    42→
    43→
    44→on_detector_registered(_invalidate_detector_names_cache)
    45→
    46→def create_parser():
    47→    """Return the top-level argparse parser."""
    48→    return _create_parser(langs=available_langs(), detector_names=_get_detector_names())
    49→
    50→
    51→def _apply_persisted_exclusions(args, config: dict):
    52→    """Merge CLI --exclude with persisted config.exclude and apply globally."""
    53→    cli_exclusions = getattr(args, "exclude", None) or []
    54→    persisted = config.get("exclude", [])
    55→    combined = list(cli_exclusions) + [e for e in persisted if e not in cli_exclusions]
    56→    if not combined:
    57→        return
    58→    set_exclusions(combined)
    59→    if cli_exclusions:
    60→        print(
    61→            colorize(f"  Excluding: {', '.join(combined)}", "dim"),
    62→            file=sys.stderr,
    63→        )
    64→        return
    65→    print(
    66→        colorize(
    67→            f"  Excluding (from config): {', '.join(combined)}", "dim"
    68→        ),
    69→        file=sys.stderr,
    70→    )
    71→
    72→
    73→def _resolve_default_path(args) -> None:
    74→    """Fill args.path from detected language or default source path.
    75→
    76→    For the review command, the last scan path (stored in state) is used as the
    77→    default so that ``desloppify review --prepare`` works on the same scope as
    78→    the preceding scan even when the project files are not under ``src/``.
    79→    """
    80→    if getattr(args, "path", None) is not None:
    81→        return
    82→    runtime_root = (
    83→        PROJECT_ROOT.resolve()
    84→        if PROJECT_ROOT is not _PROJECT_ROOT_SENTINEL and isinstance(PROJECT_ROOT, Path)
    85→        else get_project_root()
    86→    )
    87→    if getattr(args, "command", None) == "review":
    88→        try:
    89→            state_file = state_path(args)
    90→            if state_file:
    91→                saved = load_state(state_file)
    92→                saved_path = saved.get("scan_path")
    93→                if saved_path:
    94→                    args.path = str((runtime_root / saved_path).resolve())
    95→                    return
    96→        except (OSError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
    97→            logger.debug("Failed to resolve default path from saved state: %s", exc)
    98→    lang = resolve_lang(args)
    99→    if lang:
   100→        args.path = str(runtime_root / lang.default_src)
   101→    else:
   102→        args.path = str(get_default_path())
   103→
   104→
   105→def _load_shared_runtime(args) -> None:
   106→    """Load config/state and attach shared objects to parsed args."""
   107→    config = load_config()
   108→
   109→    state_file = state_path(args)
   110→    state = load_state(state_file)
   111→    _apply_persisted_exclusions(args, config)
   112→
   113→    args.runtime = CommandRuntime(config=config, state=state, state_path=state_file)
   114→
   115→
   116→def _resolve_handler(command: str):
   117→    return get_command_handlers()[command]
   118→
   119→
   120→def _handle_help_command(args, parser) -> None:
   121→    """Handle explicit help command when present in parser config."""
   122→    topic = list(getattr(args, "topic", []) or [])
   123→    try:
   124→        parser.parse_args([*topic, "--help"])
   125→    except SystemExit:
   126→        return
   127→
   128→
   129→def main() -> None:
   130→    # Ensure Unicode output works on Windows terminals (cp1252 etc.)
   131→    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
   132→        if hasattr(stream, "reconfigure"):
   133→            try:
   134→                stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
   135→            except (AttributeError, OSError):
   136→                logger.debug(
   137→                    "Skipping stream reconfigure for %s (not supported)",
   138→                    getattr(stream, "name", "<stream>"),
   139→                )
   140→
   141→    parser = create_parser()
   142→    args = parser.parse_args()
   143→    if args.command == "help":
   144→        _handle_help_command(args, parser)
   145→        return
   146→
   147→    try:
   148→        with runtime_scope():
   149→            _resolve_default_path(args)
   150→            _load_shared_runtime(args)
   151→
   152→            handler = _resolve_handler(args.command)
   153→            handler(args)
   154→    except LangResolutionError as exc:
   155→        print(colorize(f"  {exc.message}", "red"), file=sys.stderr)
   156→        sys.exit(1)
   157→    except KeyboardInterrupt:
   158→        print("\nInterrupted.")
   159→        sys.exit(1)
   160→
   161→
   162→if __name__ == "__main__":
   163→    main()

    68→def parse_batch_selection(raw: str | None, batch_count: int) -> list[int]:
    69→    """Parse optional 1-based CSV list of batches."""
    70→    if not raw:
    71→        return list(range(batch_count))
    72→
    73→    selected: list[int] = []
    74→    seen: set[int] = set()
    75→    for token in raw.split(","):
    76→        text = token.strip()
    77→        if not text:
    78→            continue
    79→        idx_1 = int(text)
    80→        if idx_1 < 1 or idx_1 > batch_count:
    81→            raise ValueError(f"batch index {idx_1} out of range 1..{batch_count}")
    82→        idx_0 = idx_1 - 1
    83→        if idx_0 in seen:
    84→            continue
    85→        seen.add(idx_0)
    86→        selected.append(idx_0)
    87→    return selected
    88→
    89→
    90→def extract_json_payload(raw: str, *, log_fn) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    91→    """Best-effort extraction of first JSON object from agent output text."""
    92→    text = raw.strip()
    93→    if not text:
    94→        return None
    95→
    96→    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
    97→    last_decode_error: json.JSONDecodeError | None = None
    98→    for start, ch in enumerate(text):
    99→        if ch not in "{[":
   100→            continue
   101→        try:
   102→            obj, _ = decoder.raw_decode(text[start:])
   103→        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
   104→            last_decode_error = exc
   105→            continue
   106→        if (
   107→            isinstance(obj, dict)
   108→            and isinstance(obj.get("assessments"), dict)
   109→            and isinstance(obj.get("findings"), list)
   110→        ):
   111→            return obj
   112→    if last_decode_error is not None:
   113→        log_fn(f"  batch output JSON parse failed: {last_decode_error.msg}")
   114→    else:
   115→        log_fn("  batch output JSON parse failed: no valid payload found")
   116→    return None
   117→

   119→def _validate_dimension_note(
   120→    key: str,
   121→    note_raw: object,
   122→) -> tuple[list[object], str, str, str, str]:
   123→    """Validate a single dimension_notes entry and return parsed fields.
   124→
   125→    Returns (evidence, impact_scope, fix_scope, confidence, issues_preventing_higher_score).
   126→    Raises ValueError on invalid structure.
   127→    """
   128→    if not isinstance(note_raw, dict):
   129→        raise ValueError(
   130→            f"dimension_notes missing object for assessed dimension: {key}"
   131→        )
   132→    evidence = note_raw.get("evidence")
   133→    impact_scope = note_raw.get("impact_scope")
   134→    fix_scope = note_raw.get("fix_scope")
   135→    if not isinstance(evidence, list) or not evidence:
   136→        raise ValueError(
   137→            f"dimension_notes.{key}.evidence must be a non-empty array"
   138→        )
   139→    if not isinstance(impact_scope, str) or not impact_scope.strip():
   140→        raise ValueError(
   141→            f"dimension_notes.{key}.impact_scope must be a non-empty string"
   142→        )
   143→    if not isinstance(fix_scope, str) or not fix_scope.strip():
   144→        raise ValueError(
   145→            f"dimension_notes.{key}.fix_scope must be a non-empty string"
   146→        )
   147→
   148→    confidence_raw = str(note_raw.get("confidence", "medium")).strip().lower()
   149→    confidence = (
   150→        confidence_raw if confidence_raw in {"high", "medium", "low"} else "medium"
   151→    )
   152→    issues_note = str(note_raw.get(DIMENSION_NOTE_ISSUES_KEY, "")).strip()
   153→    if not issues_note:
   154→        issues_note = str(note_raw.get(LEGACY_DIMENSION_NOTE_ISSUES_KEY, "")).strip()
   155→    return evidence, impact_scope, fix_scope, confidence, issues_note
   156→
   157→
   158→def _normalize_abstraction_sub_axes(
   159→    note_raw: dict[str, object],
   160→    abstraction_sub_axes: tuple[str, ...],
   161→) -> dict[str, float]:
   162→    """Extract and clamp abstraction_fitness sub-axis scores from a note."""
   163→    sub_axes_raw = note_raw.get("sub_axes")
   164→    if sub_axes_raw is not None and not isinstance(sub_axes_raw, dict):
   165→        raise ValueError(
   166→            "dimension_notes.abstraction_fitness.sub_axes must be an object"
   167→        )
   168→    if not isinstance(sub_axes_raw, dict):
   169→        return {}
   170→
   171→    normalized: dict[str, float] = {}
   172→    for axis in abstraction_sub_axes:
   173→        axis_value = sub_axes_raw.get(axis)
   174→        if axis_value is None:
   175→            continue
   176→        if isinstance(axis_value, bool) or not isinstance(
   177→            axis_value, int | float
   178→        ):
   179→            raise ValueError(
   180→                f"dimension_notes.abstraction_fitness.sub_axes.{axis} "
   181→                "must be numeric"
   182→            )
   183→        normalized[axis] = round(
   184→            max(0.0, min(100.0, float(axis_value))),
   185→            1,
   186→        )
   187→    return normalized

   189→
   190→def _normalize_findings(
   191→    raw_findings: object,
   192→    dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
   193→    *,
   194→    max_batch_findings: int,
   195→    allowed_dims: set[str],
   196→    low_score_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   197→) -> list[NormalizedBatchFinding]:
   198→    """Validate and normalize the findings array from a batch payload."""
   199→    if not isinstance(raw_findings, list):
   200→        raise ValueError("findings must be an array")
   201→
   202→    findings: list[NormalizedBatchFinding] = []
   203→    errors: list[str] = []
   204→    for idx, item in enumerate(raw_findings):
   205→        finding: ReviewFindingPayload | None
   206→        finding, finding_errors = validate_review_finding_payload(
   207→            item,
   208→            label=f"findings[{idx}]",
   209→            allowed_dimensions=allowed_dims,
   210→            allow_dismissed=False,
   211→        )
   212→        if finding_errors:
   213→            errors.extend(finding_errors)
   214→            continue
   215→        assert finding is not None
   216→
   217→        dim = finding["dimension"]
   218→        note = dimension_notes.get(dim, {})
   219→        impact_scope = str(
   220→            (item if isinstance(item, dict) else {}).get(
   221→                "impact_scope", note.get("impact_scope", "")
   222→            )
   223→        ).strip()
   224→        fix_scope = str(
   225→            (item if isinstance(item, dict) else {}).get(
   226→                "fix_scope", note.get("fix_scope", "")
   227→            )
   228→        ).strip()
   229→        if not impact_scope or not fix_scope:
   230→            errors.append(
   231→                f"findings[{idx}] requires impact_scope and fix_scope "
   232→                "(or dimension_notes defaults)"
   233→            )
   234→            continue
   235→        findings.append(
   236→            NormalizedBatchFinding(
   237→                dimension=finding["dimension"],
   238→                identifier=finding["identifier"],
   239→                summary=finding["summary"],
   240→                confidence=finding["confidence"],
   241→                suggestion=finding["suggestion"],
   242→                related_files=list(finding.get("related_files", [])),
   243→                evidence=list(finding.get("evidence", [])),
   244→                impact_scope=impact_scope,
   245→                fix_scope=fix_scope,
   246→                reasoning=str(finding.get("reasoning", "")),
   247→                evidence_lines=list(finding.get("evidence_lines", []))
   248→                if isinstance(finding.get("evidence_lines"), list)
   249→                else None,
   250→            )
   251→        )
   252→    if errors:
   253→        visible = errors[:10]
   254→        remaining = len(errors) - len(visible)
   255→        if remaining > 0:
   256→            visible.append(f"... {remaining} additional finding schema error(s) omitted")
   257→        raise ValueError("; ".join(visible))
   258→    if len(findings) <= max_batch_findings:
   259→        return findings
   260→
   261→    required_dims = set(low_score_dimensions or set())
   262→    if not required_dims:
   263→        return findings[:max_batch_findings]
   264→
   265→    # Preserve at least one finding per low-score dimension before trimming.
   266→    selected: list[NormalizedBatchFinding] = []
   267→    selected_indexes: set[int] = set()
   268→    covered: set[str] = set()
   269→    for idx, finding in enumerate(findings):
   270→        if len(selected) >= max_batch_findings:
   271→            break
   272→        dim = finding.dimension.strip()
   273→        if dim not in required_dims or dim in covered:
   274→            continue
   275→        selected.append(finding)
   276→        selected_indexes.add(idx)
   277→        covered.add(dim)
   278→
   279→    for idx, finding in enumerate(findings):
   280→        if len(selected) >= max_batch_findings:
   281→            break
   282→        if idx in selected_indexes:
   283→            continue
   284→        selected.append(finding)
   285→    return selected

   288→def _low_score_dimensions(assessments: dict[str, float]) -> set[str]:
   289→    """Return assessed dimensions requiring explicit defect findings."""
   290→    return {
   291→        dim
   292→        for dim, score in assessments.items()
   293→        if score < LOW_SCORE_FINDING_THRESHOLD
   294→    }

   296→
   297→def _enforce_low_score_findings(
   298→    *,
   299→    assessments: dict[str, float],
   300→    findings: list[NormalizedBatchFinding],
   301→) -> None:
   302→    """Fail closed when low scores do not report explicit findings."""
   303→    required_dims = _low_score_dimensions(assessments)
   304→    if not required_dims:
   305→        return
   306→    finding_dims = {
   307→        finding.dimension.strip() for finding in findings
   308→    }
   309→    missing = sorted(dim for dim in required_dims if dim not in finding_dims)
   310→    if not missing:
   311→        return
   312→    joined = ", ".join(missing)
   313→    raise ValueError(
   314→        "low-score dimensions must include at least one explicit finding: "
   315→        f"{joined} (threshold {LOW_SCORE_FINDING_THRESHOLD:.1f})"
   316→    )

   319→def _compute_batch_quality(

   325→) -> dict[str, float]:
   326→    """Compute quality metrics for a single batch result."""

   330→            3,
   331→        ),
   332→        "evidence_density": round(
   333→            sum(len(note.get("evidence", [])) for note in dimension_notes.values())

   351→    dict[str, float],
   352→]:
   353→    """Validate and normalize one batch payload."""
   354→    if "assessments" not in payload:
   355→        raise ValueError("payload missing required key: assessments")
   356→    if "findings" not in payload:
   357→        raise ValueError("payload missing required key: findings")
   358→
   359→    raw_assessments = payload.get("assessments")
   360→    if not isinstance(raw_assessments, dict):
   361→        raise ValueError("assessments must be an object")
   362→
   363→    raw_dimension_notes = payload.get("dimension_notes", {})
   364→    if not isinstance(raw_dimension_notes, dict):
   365→        raise ValueError("dimension_notes must be an object")
   366→
   367→    assessments: dict[str, float] = {}
   368→    dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   369→    high_score_missing_issue_note = 0.0
   370→    for key, value in raw_assessments.items():
   371→        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
   372→            continue
   373→        if key not in allowed_dims:
   374→            continue
   375→        if isinstance(value, bool):
   376→            continue
   377→        if not isinstance(value, int | float):
   378→            continue
   379→        score = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value))), 1)
   380→
   381→        note_raw = raw_dimension_notes.get(key)
   382→        evidence, impact_scope, fix_scope, confidence, issues_note = (
   383→            _validate_dimension_note(key, note_raw)
   384→        )
   385→        assert isinstance(note_raw, dict)
   386→        if score > HIGH_SCORE_ISSUES_NOTE_THRESHOLD and not issues_note:
   387→            high_score_missing_issue_note += 1
   388→
   389→        normalized_sub_axes: dict[str, float] = {}
   390→        if key == "abstraction_fitness" and isinstance(note_raw, dict):
   391→            normalized_sub_axes = _normalize_abstraction_sub_axes(
   392→                note_raw, abstraction_sub_axes
   393→            )
   394→
   395→        assessments[key] = score
   396→        dimension_notes[key] = {
   397→            "evidence": [str(item).strip() for item in evidence if str(item).strip()],
   398→            "impact_scope": impact_scope.strip(),
   399→            "fix_scope": fix_scope.strip(),
   400→            "confidence": confidence,
   401→            DIMENSION_NOTE_ISSUES_KEY: issues_note,
   402→        }
   403→        if normalized_sub_axes:
   404→            dimension_notes[key]["sub_axes"] = normalized_sub_axes
   405→
   406→    findings = _normalize_findings(
   407→        payload.get("findings"),
   408→        dimension_notes,
   409→        max_batch_findings=max_batch_findings,
   410→        allowed_dims=allowed_dims,
   411→        low_score_dimensions=_low_score_dimensions(assessments),
   412→    )
   413→    _enforce_low_score_findings(assessments=assessments, findings=findings)
   414→
   415→    quality = _compute_batch_quality(
   416→        assessments,
   417→        findings,
   418→        dimension_notes,
   419→        allowed_dims,
   420→        high_score_missing_issue_note,
   421→    )
   422→    return (
   423→        assessments,
   424→        [finding.to_payload() for finding in findings],
   425→        dimension_notes,
   426→        quality,
   427→    )
   428→
   429→
   430→def assessment_weight(
   431→    *,
   432→    dimension: str,
   433→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   434→    dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
   435→) -> float:
   436→    """Evidence-weighted assessment score weight with a neutral floor.
   437→
   438→    Weighting is evidence-based and score-independent: the raw score does not
   439→    influence how much weight a batch contributes during merge.
   440→    """
   441→    note = dimension_notes.get(dimension, {})
   442→    note_evidence = len(note.get("evidence", [])) if isinstance(note, dict) else 0
   443→    finding_count = sum(
   444→        1
   445→        for finding in findings
   446→        if str(finding.get("dimension", "")).strip() == dimension
   447→    )
   448→    return float(1 + note_evidence + finding_count)
   449→
   450→
   451→def _finding_pressure_by_dimension(
   452→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   453→    *,
   454→    dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
   455→) -> tuple[dict[str, float], dict[str, int]]:
   456→    """Summarize how strongly findings should pull dimension scores down."""
   457→    return _DIMENSION_SCORER.finding_pressure_by_dimension(
   458→        findings,
   459→        dimension_notes=dimension_notes,
   460→    )
   461→
   462→
   463→def _accumulate_batch_scores(
   464→    result: dict[str, Any],
   465→    *,
   466→    score_buckets: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]],
   467→    score_raw_by_dim: dict[str, list[float]],
   468→    merged_dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
   469→    abstraction_axis_scores: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]],
   470→    abstraction_sub_axes: tuple[str, ...],
   471→) -> None:
   472→    """Accumulate assessment scores, dimension notes, and sub-axis data from one batch."""
   473→    result_findings = result.get("findings", [])
   474→    result_notes = result.get("dimension_notes", {})
   475→    for key, score in result.get("assessments", {}).items():
   476→        if isinstance(score, bool):
   477→            continue
   478→        score_value = float(score)
   479→        weight = assessment_weight(
   480→            dimension=key,
   481→            findings=result_findings,
   482→            dimension_notes=result_notes,
   483→        )
   484→        score_buckets.setdefault(key, []).append((score_value, weight))
   485→        score_raw_by_dim.setdefault(key, []).append(score_value)
   486→
   487→        note = result_notes.get(key)
   488→        existing = merged_dimension_notes.get(key)
   489→        existing_evidence = (
   490→            len(existing.get("evidence", [])) if isinstance(existing, dict) else -1
   491→        )
   492→        current_evidence = (
   493→            len(note.get("evidence", [])) if isinstance(note, dict) else -1
   494→        )
   495→        if current_evidence > existing_evidence:
   496→            merged_dimension_notes[key] = note
   497→
   498→        if key == "abstraction_fitness" and isinstance(note, dict):
   499→            sub_axes = note.get("sub_axes")
   500→            if isinstance(sub_axes, dict):
   501→                for axis in abstraction_sub_axes:
   502→                    axis_score = sub_axes.get(axis)
   503→                    if isinstance(axis_score, bool) or not isinstance(
   504→                        axis_score, int | float
   505→                    ):
   506→                        continue
   507→                    abstraction_axis_scores[axis].append(
   508→                        (float(axis_score), weight)
   509→                    )
   510→
   511→
   512→def _finding_identity_key(finding: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   513→    """Build a stable concept key; prefer dimension+identifier when available."""
   514→    dim = str(finding.get("dimension", "")).strip()
   515→    ident = str(finding.get("identifier", "")).strip()
   516→    if ident:
   517→        return f"{dim}::{ident}"
   518→    summary = str(finding.get("summary", "")).strip()
   519→    summary_terms = sorted(normalize_word_set(summary))
   520→    if summary_terms:
   521→        return f"{dim}::summary::{','.join(summary_terms[:8])}"
   522→    return f"{dim}::{summary}"
   523→
   524→
   525→def _merge_finding_payload(existing: dict[str, Any], incoming: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   526→    """Merge two concept-equivalent findings into the existing payload."""
   527→    merge_list_fields(existing, incoming, ("related_files", "evidence"))
   528→    # Prefer richer summary/suggestion text when they differ.
   529→    pick_longer_text(existing, incoming, "summary")
   530→    pick_longer_text(existing, incoming, "suggestion")
   531→    track_merged_from(existing, str(incoming.get("identifier", "")).strip())
   532→
   533→
   534→def _should_merge_findings(existing: dict[str, Any], incoming: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
   535→    """Check whether two key-matched findings are similar enough to merge."""
   536→    existing_summary = normalize_word_set(str(existing.get("summary", "")))
   537→    incoming_summary = normalize_word_set(str(incoming.get("summary", "")))
   538→    if existing_summary and incoming_summary:
   539→        overlap = len(existing_summary & incoming_summary)
   540→        union = len(existing_summary | incoming_summary)
   541→        if union and overlap / union >= 0.3:
   542→            return True
   543→    # Fall back to related-file overlap
   544→    existing_files = set(existing.get("related_files", []))
   545→    incoming_files = set(incoming.get("related_files", []))
   546→    if existing_files and incoming_files:
   547→        return bool(existing_files & incoming_files)
   548→    # When no corroborating signal is available, allow merge
   549→    return not existing_summary or not incoming_summary
   550→
   551→
   552→def _accumulate_batch_findings(
   553→    result: dict[str, Any],
   554→    finding_map: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
   555→) -> None:
   556→    """Deduplicate and accumulate findings from one batch into finding_map."""
   557→    suffix_counter: dict[str, int] = {}
   558→    for finding in result.get("findings", []):
   559→        [REDACTED](finding)
   560→        existing = finding_map.get(dedupe_key)
   561→        if existing is None:
   562→            finding_map[dedupe_key] = finding
   563→            continue
   564→        if _should_merge_findings(existing, finding):
   565→            _merge_finding_payload(existing, finding)
   566→        else:
   567→            # Distinct finding with reused identifier — assign unique key
   568→            count = suffix_counter.get(dedupe_key, 0) + 1
   569→            suffix_counter[dedupe_key] = count
   570→            finding_map[f"{dedupe_key}##dup{count}"] = finding
   571→
   572→
   573→def _accumulate_batch_quality(
   574→    result: dict[str, Any],
   575→    *,
   576→    coverage_values: list[float],
   577→    evidence_density_values: list[float],
   578→) -> float:
   579→    """Accumulate quality metrics from one batch. Returns high-score-missing-issues delta."""
   580→    quality = result.get("quality", {})
   581→    if not isinstance(quality, dict):
   582→        return 0.0
   583→    coverage = quality.get("dimension_coverage")
   584→    density = quality.get("evidence_density")
   585→    missing_issue_note = quality.get(REVIEW_QUALITY_HIGH_SCORE_MISSING_ISSUES_KEY)
   586→    if not isinstance(missing_issue_note, int | float):
   587→        missing_issue_note = quality.get(
   588→            LEGACY_REVIEW_QUALITY_HIGH_SCORE_MISSING_ISSUES_KEY
   589→        )
   590→    if isinstance(coverage, int | float):
   591→        coverage_values.append(float(coverage))
   592→    if isinstance(density, int | float):
   593→        evidence_density_values.append(float(density))
   594→    return (
   595→        float(missing_issue_note)
   596→        if isinstance(missing_issue_note, int | float)
   597→        else 0.0
   598→    )
   599→
   600→
   601→def _compute_merged_assessments(
   602→    score_buckets: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]],
   603→    score_raw_by_dim: dict[str, list[float]],
   604→    finding_pressure_by_dim: dict[str, float],
   605→    finding_count_by_dim: dict[str, int],
   606→) -> dict[str, float]:
   607→    """Compute pressure-adjusted weighted mean for each dimension."""
   608→    return _DIMENSION_SCORER.merge_scores(
   609→        score_buckets,
   610→        score_raw_by_dim,
   611→        finding_pressure_by_dim,
   612→        finding_count_by_dim,
   613→    )
   614→
   615→
   616→def _compute_abstraction_components(
   617→    merged_assessments: dict[str, float],
   618→    abstraction_axis_scores: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]],
   619→    *,
   620→    abstraction_sub_axes: tuple[str, ...],
   621→    abstraction_component_names: dict[str, str],
   622→) -> dict[str, float] | None:
   623→    """Compute weighted abstraction sub-axis component scores.
   624→
   625→    Returns component_scores dict, or None if abstraction_fitness is not assessed.
   626→    """
   627→    abstraction_score = merged_assessments.get("abstraction_fitness")
   628→    if abstraction_score is None:
   629→        return None
   630→
   631→    component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   632→    for axis in abstraction_sub_axes:
   633→        weighted = abstraction_axis_scores.get(axis, [])
   634→        if not weighted:
   635→            continue
   636→        numerator = sum(score * weight for score, weight in weighted)
   637→        denominator = sum(weight for _, weight in weighted)
   638→        if denominator <= 0:
   639→            continue
   640→        component_scores[abstraction_component_names[axis]] = round(
   641→            max(0.0, min(100.0, numerator / denominator)),
   642→            1,
   643→        )
   644→    return component_scores if component_scores else None
   645→
   646→
   647→def merge_batch_results(
   648→    batch_results: list[dict[str, Any]],
   649→    *,
   650→    abstraction_sub_axes: tuple[str, ...],
   651→    abstraction_component_names: dict[str, str],
   652→) -> dict[str, object]:
   653→    """Deterministically merge assessments/findings across batch outputs."""
   654→    score_buckets: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]] = {}
   655→    score_raw_by_dim: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
   656→    finding_map: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   657→    merged_dimension_notes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   658→    coverage_values: list[float] = []
   659→    evidence_density_values: list[float] = []
   660→    high_score_missing_issue_note_total = 0.0
   661→    abstraction_axis_scores: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]] = {
   662→        axis: [] for axis in abstraction_sub_axes
   663→    }
   664→
   665→    for result in batch_results:
   666→        _accumulate_batch_scores(
   667→            result,
   668→            score_buckets=score_buckets,
   669→            score_raw_by_dim=score_raw_by_dim,
   670→            merged_dimension_notes=merged_dimension_notes,
   671→            abstraction_axis_scores=abstraction_axis_scores,
   672→            abstraction_sub_axes=abstraction_sub_axes,
   673→        )
   674→        _accumulate_batch_findings(result, finding_map)
   675→        high_score_missing_issue_note_total += _accumulate_batch_quality(
   676→            result,
   677→            coverage_values=coverage_values,
   678→            evidence_density_values=evidence_density_values,
   679→        )
   680→
   681→    merged_findings = list(finding_map.values())
   682→    finding_pressure_by_dim, finding_count_by_dim = _finding_pressure_by_dimension(
   683→        merged_findings,
   684→        dimension_notes=merged_dimension_notes,
   685→    )
   686→
   687→    merged_assessments = _compute_merged_assessments(
   688→        score_buckets, score_raw_by_dim, finding_pressure_by_dim, finding_count_by_dim
   689→    )
   690→
   691→    merged_assessment_payload: dict[str, float | dict[str, object]] = {
   692→        key: value for key, value in merged_assessments.items()
   693→    }
   694→    component_scores = _compute_abstraction_components(
   695→        merged_assessments,
   696→        abstraction_axis_scores,
   697→        abstraction_sub_axes=abstraction_sub_axes,
   698→        abstraction_component_names=abstraction_component_names,
   699→    )
   700→    if component_scores is not None:
   701→        merged_assessment_payload["abstraction_fitness"] = {
   702→            "score": merged_assessments["abstraction_fitness"],
   703→            "components": list(component_scores),
   704→            "component_scores": component_scores,
   705→        }
   706→
   707→    return {
   708→        "assessments": merged_assessment_payload,
   709→        "dimension_notes": merged_dimension_notes,
   710→        "findings": merged_findings,
   711→        "review_quality": {
   712→            "batch_count": len(batch_results),
   713→            "dimension_coverage": round(
   714→                sum(coverage_values) / max(len(coverage_values), 1),
   715→                3,
   716→            ),
   717→            "evidence_density": round(
   718→                sum(evidence_density_values) / max(len(evidence_density_values), 1),
   719→                3,
   720→            ),
   721→            REVIEW_QUALITY_HIGH_SCORE_MISSING_ISSUES_KEY: int(
   722→                high_score_missing_issue_note_total
   723→            ),
   724→            "finding_pressure": round(sum(finding_pressure_by_dim.values()), 3),
   725→            "dimensions_with_findings": len(finding_count_by_dim),
   726→        },
   727→    }
   728→
   729→
   730→def build_batch_prompt(
   731→    *,
   732→    repo_root: Path,
   733→    packet_path: Path,
   734→    batch_index: int,
   735→    batch: dict[str, object],
   736→) -> str:
   737→    """Render one subagent prompt for a holistic investigation batch."""
   738→    return render_batch_prompt(
   739→        repo_root=repo_root,
   740→        packet_path=packet_path,
   741→        batch_index=batch_index,
   742→        batch=batch,

    31→    return float(overlap) / float(union) if union else 0.0

    60→        return False

   139→        if len(group) > 1:
   140→            merge_groups.append(group)
   141→
   142→    if not merge_groups:
   143→        print(
   144→            colorize(
   145→                "\n  No duplicate issue concepts found at the current similarity threshold.\n",
   146→                "dim",
   147→            )
   148→        )
   149→        return
   150→
   151→    dry_run = bool(getattr(args, "dry_run", False))
   152→    prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   153→    timestamp = utc_now()
   154→    merged_pairs: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
   155→    for group in merge_groups:
   156→        ranked = sorted(
   157→            group,
   158→            key=lambda finding: (finding_weight(finding)[0], finding.get("id", "")),
   159→            reverse=True,
   160→        )
   161→        primary = ranked[0]
   162→        duplicates = ranked[1:]
   163→        merged_pairs.append((primary.get("id", ""), [d.get("id", "") for d in duplicates]))
   164→        if dry_run:
   165→            continue
   166→        for duplicate in duplicates:
   167→            _merge_finding_details(primary, duplicate)
   168→            duplicate["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   169→            duplicate["resolved_at"] = timestamp
   170→            duplicate["note"] = f"merged into {primary.get('id', '')}"
   171→            duplicate["resolution_attestation"] = {
   172→                "kind": "issue_merge",
   173→                "text": "Merged conceptually duplicate review finding",
   174→                "attested_at": timestamp,
   175→                "scan_verified": False,
   176→            }
   177→        primary_detail = primary.setdefault("detail", {})
   178→        primary_detail["merged_at"] = timestamp
   179→
   180→    print(
   181→        colorize(
   182→            f"\n  Merge groups: {len(merge_groups)} | "
   183→            f"duplicate findings: {sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups)}",
   184→            "bold",
   185→        )
   186→    )
   187→    for index, (primary_id, duplicate_ids) in enumerate(merged_pairs, 1):
   188→        preview = ", ".join(duplicate_ids[:3])
   189→        if len(duplicate_ids) > 3:
   190→            preview = f"{preview}, +{len(duplicate_ids) - 3} more"
   191→        print(colorize(f"  [{index}] keep {primary_id}", "dim"))
   192→        print(colorize(f"      merge {preview}", "dim"))
   193→
   194→    if dry_run:
   195→        print(colorize("\n  Dry run only: no state changes written.\n", "yellow"))
   196→        return
   197→
   198→    save_state(state, state_file)
   199→    print(colorize("\n  State updated with merged issue groups.", "green"))
   200→    show_score_with_plan_context(state, prev)
   201→    write_query(
   202→        {
   203→            "command": "review",
   204→            "action": "merge",
   205→            "groups": len(merge_groups),
   206→            "duplicates_merged": sum(len(group) - 1 for group in merge_groups),
   207→            "next_command": "desloppify show review --status open",
   208→            "narrative": narrative,
   209→        }
   210→    )
   211→

    22→def _resolve_lang_from_state(state: StateModel) -> str | None:
    23→    """Best-effort language detection from state (scan_history > lang_capabilities)."""
    24→    history = state.get("scan_history")
    25→    if isinstance(history, list):
    26→        for entry in reversed(history):
    27→            if isinstance(entry, dict):
    28→                lang = entry.get("lang")
    29→                if isinstance(lang, str) and lang.strip():
    30→                    return lang.strip().lower()
    31→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
    32→    if isinstance(capabilities, dict) and len(capabilities) == 1:
    33→        only_lang = next(iter(capabilities.keys()))
    34→        if isinstance(only_lang, str) and only_lang.strip():
    35→            return only_lang.strip().lower()
    36→    return None

    39→def _count_findings(findings: dict) -> tuple[dict[str, int], dict[int, dict[str, int]]]:
    40→    """Tally per-status counters and per-tier breakdowns."""
    41→    counters = dict.fromkeys(_EMPTY_COUNTERS, 0)
    42→    tier_stats: dict[int, dict[str, int]] = {}
    43→
    44→    for finding in findings.values():
    45→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    46→            continue
    47→        status = finding["status"]
    48→        tier = finding.get("tier", 3)
    49→        counters[status] = counters.get(status, 0) + 1
    50→        tier_counter = tier_stats.setdefault(tier, dict.fromkeys(_EMPTY_COUNTERS, 0))
    51→        tier_counter[status] = tier_counter.get(status, 0) + 1
    52→
    53→    return counters, tier_stats

    56→def _coerce_subjective_score(value: dict | float | int | str | None) -> float:

   274→
   275→def _update_objective_health(
   276→    state: StateModel,
   277→    findings: dict,
   278→    *,
   279→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None,
   280→) -> None:
   281→    """Compute canonical score trio from dimension scoring."""
   282→    pots = state.get("potentials", {})
   283→    if not pots:
   284→        return
   285→
   286→    # Deferred import to avoid circular dependency with desloppify.scoring
   287→    # (scoring -> _scoring/results/core -> _scoring/subjective/core -> review -> state -> _state/merge -> _state/scoring)
   288→    from desloppify.scoring import (
   289→        compute_health_score,
   290→        compute_score_bundle,
   291→        merge_potentials,
   292→    )
   293→
   294→    merged = merge_potentials(pots)
   295→    if not merged:
   296→        return
   297→
   298→    subjective_assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments") or None
   299→    integrity_target = (
   300→        max(0.0, min(100.0, float(subjective_integrity_target)))
   301→        if isinstance(subjective_integrity_target, int | float)
   302→        else None
   303→    )
   304→    integrity_meta = _subjective_integrity_baseline(integrity_target)
   305→    if subjective_assessments and integrity_target is not None:
   306→        subjective_assessments, integrity_meta = _apply_subjective_integrity_policy(
   307→            subjective_assessments,
   308→            target=integrity_target,
   309→        )
   310→    state["subjective_integrity"] = integrity_meta
   311→
   312→    has_active_checks = any((count or 0) > 0 for count in merged.values())
   313→    if not has_active_checks and not subjective_assessments:
   314→        state["dimension_scores"] = {}
   315→        state["overall_score"] = 100.0
   316→        state["objective_score"] = 100.0
   317→        state["strict_score"] = 100.0
   318→        state["verified_strict_score"] = 100.0
   319→        return
   320→
   321→    # Use the full scorecard dimensions for 0-score placeholders so every
   322→    # dimension the review workflow covers gets a placeholder when unreviewed.
   323→    # Explicit assessments outside this set still count
   324→    # (append_subjective_dimensions handles that).
   325→    allowed_subjective: set[str] | None = None
   326→    lang_name = _resolve_lang_from_state(state)
   327→    if lang_name:
   328→        try:
   329→            from desloppify.intelligence.review.dimensions.data import (
   330→                load_dimensions_for_lang,
   331→            )
   332→
   333→            dims, _, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name)
   334→            if dims:
   335→                allowed_subjective = set(dims)
   336→        except (ImportError, AttributeError) as exc:
   337→            _ = exc
   338→
   339→    bundle = compute_score_bundle(
   340→        findings,
   341→        merged,
   342→        subjective_assessments=subjective_assessments,
   343→        allowed_subjective_dimensions=allowed_subjective,
   344→    )
   345→    lenient_scores = bundle.dimension_scores
   346→    strict_scores = bundle.strict_dimension_scores
   347→    verified_strict_scores = bundle.verified_strict_dimension_scores
   348→
   349→    prev_dim_scores = dict(state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   350→
   351→    state["dimension_scores"] = {
   352→        name: dict(
   353→            score=lenient_scores[name]["score"],
   354→            strict_score=strict_scores[name]["score"],
   355→            verified_strict_score=verified_strict_scores[name]["score"],
   356→            checks=lenient_scores[name]["checks"],
   357→            issues=lenient_scores[name]["issues"],
   358→            tier=lenient_scores[name]["tier"],
   359→            detectors=lenient_scores[name].get("detectors", {}),
   360→        )
   361→        for name in lenient_scores
   362→    }
   363→    for data in state["dimension_scores"].values():
   364→        data["strict"] = data["strict_score"]
   365→
   366→    # Carry forward mechanical dimensions from a prior scan that are absent
   367→    # now (e.g. duplication when --skip-slow is used).
   368→    for dim_name, prev_data in prev_dim_scores.items():
   369→        if dim_name in state["dimension_scores"]:
   370→            continue
   371→        if not isinstance(prev_data, dict):
   372→            continue
   373→        if "subjective_assessment" in prev_data.get("detectors", {}):
   374→            continue
   375→        carried = {**prev_data, "carried_forward": True}
   376→        # Backfill for state files written before verified_strict_score existed.
   377→        carried.setdefault(
   378→            "verified_strict_score",
   379→            carried.get("strict_score", carried.get("strict", carried.get("score", 0.0))),
   380→        )
   381→        state["dimension_scores"][dim_name] = carried
   382→
   383→    _apply_scan_coverage_to_dimension_scores(
   384→        state,
   385→        dimension_scores=state["dimension_scores"],
   386→    )
   387→
   388→    state.update(_aggregate_scores(state["dimension_scores"], compute_health_score))
   389→
   390→
   391→def _recompute_stats(
   392→    state: StateModel,
   393→    scan_path: str | None = None,
   394→    *,
   395→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None,
   396→) -> None:
   397→    """Recompute stats and canonical health scores from findings."""
   398→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   399→    findings = path_scoped_findings(state["findings"], scan_path)
   400→    counters, tier_stats = _count_findings(findings)
   401→    state["stats"] = {
   402→        "total": sum(counters.values()),
   403→        **counters,
   404→        "by_tier": {
   405→            str(tier): tier_counts for tier, tier_counts in sorted(tier_stats.items())
   406→        },
   407→    }
   408→    _update_objective_health(
   409→        state,
   410→        findings,
   411→        subjective_integrity_target=subjective_integrity_target,
   412→    )
   413→
   414→
   415→def _empty_suppression_metrics() -> dict[str, int | float]:
   416→    return {
   417→        "last_ignored": 0,
   418→        "last_raw_findings": 0,
   419→        "last_suppressed_pct": 0.0,
   420→        "last_ignore_patterns": 0,
   421→        "recent_scans": 0,
   422→        "recent_ignored": 0,
   423→        "recent_raw_findings": 0,
   424→        "recent_suppressed_pct": 0.0,
   425→    }
   426→
   427→
   428→def suppression_metrics(state: StateModel, *, window: int = 5) -> dict[str, int | float]:
   429→    """Summarize ignore suppression from recent scan history."""
   430→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
   431→    if not history:
   432→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   433→
   434→    scans_with_suppression = [
   435→        entry
   436→        for entry in history
   437→        if isinstance(entry, dict)
   438→        and (
   439→            "ignored" in entry
   440→            or "raw_findings" in entry
   441→            or "suppressed_pct" in entry
   442→            or "ignore_patterns" in entry
   443→        )
   444→    ]
   445→    if not scans_with_suppression:
   446→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   447→
   448→    recent = scans_with_suppression[-max(1, window) :]
   449→    last = recent[-1]
   450→
   451→    recent_ignored = sum(int(entry.get("ignored", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   452→    recent_raw = sum(int(entry.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   453→    recent_pct = round(recent_ignored / recent_raw * 100, 1) if recent_raw else 0.0
   454→
   455→    last_ignored = int(last.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   456→    last_raw = int(last.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0)
   457→    if "suppressed_pct" in last:
   458→        last_pct = round(float(last.get("suppressed_pct") or 0.0), 1)
   459→    else:
   460→        last_pct = round(last_ignored / last_raw * 100, 1) if last_raw else 0.0
   461→
   462→    return {
   463→        "last_ignored": last_ignored,
   464→        "last_raw_findings": last_raw,
   465→        "last_suppressed_pct": last_pct,
   466→        "last_ignore_patterns": int(last.get("ignore_patterns", 0) or 0),
   467→        "recent_scans": len(recent),
   468→        "recent_ignored": recent_ignored,
   469→        "recent_raw_findings": recent_raw,
   470→        "recent_suppressed_pct": recent_pct,
   471→    }
   472→

1→"""Passthrough/forwarding detection: shared classification algorithm.
     2→
     3→Language-specific extraction lives in language plugins. This module provides
     4→the shared core that classifies parameters as passthrough vs direct-use.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→import re
     8→from collections.abc import Callable
     9→
    10→
    11→def classify_passthrough_tier(
    12→    passthrough_count: int,
    13→    ratio: float,
    14→    *,
    15→    has_spread: bool = False,
    16→) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
    17→    """Classify passthrough severity into (tier, confidence) or None to skip."""
    18→    rules: list[tuple[bool, tuple[int, str]]] = [
    19→        (passthrough_count >= 20 or ratio >= 0.8, (4, "high")),
    20→        (
    21→            passthrough_count >= 8 and ratio >= 0.5,
    22→            (3, "high" if ratio >= 0.7 else "medium"),
    23→        ),
    24→        (has_spread and passthrough_count >= 4, (3, "medium")),
    25→    ]
    26→    for matched, classification in rules:
    27→        if matched:
    28→            return classification
    29→    return None
    30→
    31→
    32→def classify_params(
    33→    params: list[str],
    34→    body: str,
    35→    make_pattern: Callable[[str], str],
    36→    occurrences_per_match: int = 2,
    37→) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    38→    """Classify params as passthrough vs direct-use.
    39→
    40→    For each param, count total word-boundary occurrences vs passthrough
    41→    pattern matches. If ALL occurrences are accounted for by passthrough
    42→    patterns, it's passthrough.
    43→
    44→    Args:
    45→        params: Parameter names to classify.
    46→        body: Function/component body text.
    47→        make_pattern: Returns a regex that matches passthrough usage of a param name.
    48→        occurrences_per_match: How many \\bname\\b occurrences each passthrough match accounts for.
    49→
    50→    Returns:
    51→        (passthrough_params, direct_params)
    52→    """
    53→    passthrough = []
    54→    direct = []
    55→    for name in params:
    56→        total = len(re.findall(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", body))
    57→        if total == 0:
    58→            # Unused param — not passthrough, not direct-use either.
    59→            # Count as direct (it's destructured, just unused).
    60→            direct.append(name)
    61→            continue
    62→        pt_matches = len(re.findall(make_pattern(name), body))
    63→        pt_occurrences = pt_matches * occurrences_per_match
    64→        if pt_occurrences >= total:
    65→            passthrough.append(name)
    66→        else:
    67→            direct.append(name)
    68→    return passthrough, direct
    69→

   316→def _apply_lang_overrides(runtime: LangRun, overrides: LangRunOverrides) -> None:

   318→    for field_name in _LANG_OVERRIDE_FIELDS:
   319→        value = getattr(overrides, field_name)
   320→        if value is _UNSET:
   321→            continue
   322→        coerced = _coerce_lang_override(field_name, value)
   323→        if field_name == "review_max_age_days" and coerced is None:

   341→        runtime.state.runtime_options = copy.deepcopy(
   342→            getattr(lang, "_default_runtime_options", {})
   343→        )
   344→
   345→    resolved = overrides if overrides is not None else LangRunOverrides()
   346→    _apply_lang_overrides(runtime, resolved)
   347→    return runtime

   254→    def __getattr__(self, name: str):
   255→        if name in _FORWARDED_CONFIG_ATTRS:
   256→            return getattr(self.config, name)
   257→        raise AttributeError(
   258→            f"{self.__class__.__name__!s} has no attribute {name!r}; "
   259→            "access runtime state via explicit LangRun properties"
   260→        )
   261→
   262→    def __dir__(self):
   263→        """Expose LangConfig + mutable runtime fields for discoverability."""
   264→        return (
   265→            list(super().__dir__())
   266→            + sorted(_FORWARDED_CONFIG_ATTRS)
   267→            + sorted(_LANG_RUNTIME_STATE_FIELDS)
   268→        )
   269→
   270→    @property
   271→    def large_threshold(self) -> int:
   272→        override = self.state.large_threshold_override
   273→        if isinstance(override, int) and override > 0:
   274→            return override
   275→        return self.config.large_threshold
   276→
   277→    @property
   278→    def props_threshold(self) -> int:
   279→        override = self.state.props_threshold_override
   280→        if isinstance(override, int) and override > 0:
   281→            return override
   282→        return self.config.props_threshold
   283→
   284→    def runtime_setting(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
   285→        if key in self.state.runtime_settings:
   286→            return self.state.runtime_settings[key]
   287→        spec = self.config.setting_specs.get(key)
   288→        if spec:
   289→            return copy.deepcopy(spec.default)
   290→        return default
   291→
   292→    def runtime_option(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
   293→        if key in self.state.runtime_options:
   294→            return self.state.runtime_options[key]
   295→        spec = self.config.runtime_option_specs.get(key)
   296→        if spec:
   297→            return copy.deepcopy(spec.default)
   298→        return default
   299→
   300→
   301→def _coerce_lang_override(field_name: str, value: object) -> object:
   302→    """Normalize override values to LangRuntimeState-compatible payloads."""
   303→    if field_name in _LANG_OVERRIDE_DICT_FIELDS:
   304→        return value or {}
   305→    if field_name in _LANG_OVERRIDE_LIST_FIELDS:
   306→        return value or []
   307→    if field_name in _LANG_OVERRIDE_INT_FIELDS:
   308→        return int(value or 0)
   309→    if field_name == "review_max_age_days":
   310→        if value is None:
   311→            return None
   312→        return int(value)
   313→    return value
   314→
   315→
   316→def _apply_lang_overrides(runtime: LangRun, overrides: LangRunOverrides) -> None:
   317→    """Apply override bundle to runtime state via one normalized loop."""
   318→    for field_name in _LANG_OVERRIDE_FIELDS:
   319→        value = getattr(overrides, field_name)
   320→        if value is _UNSET:
   321→            continue
   322→        coerced = _coerce_lang_override(field_name, value)
   323→        if field_name == "review_max_age_days" and coerced is None:
   324→            continue
   325→        setattr(runtime, field_name, coerced)
   326→
   327→
   328→def make_lang_run(
   329→    lang: LangConfig | LangRun,
   330→    overrides: LangRunOverrides | None = None,
   331→) -> LangRun:
   332→    """Build a fresh LangRun for a command invocation."""
   333→
   334→    if isinstance(lang, LangRun):
   335→        runtime = lang
   336→    else:
   337→        runtime = LangRun(config=lang)
   338→        runtime.state.runtime_settings = copy.deepcopy(
   339→            getattr(lang, "_default_runtime_settings", {})
   340→        )
   341→        runtime.state.runtime_options = copy.deepcopy(
   342→            getattr(lang, "_default_runtime_options", {})
   343→        )
   344→
   345→    resolved = overrides if overrides is not None else LangRunOverrides()
   346→    _apply_lang_overrides(runtime, resolved)
   347→    return runtime
   348→
   349→
   350→__all__ = [
   351→    "LangRuntimeContract",
   352→    "LangRun",
   353→    "LangRunOverrides",
   354→    "LangRuntimeState",
   355→    "make_lang_run",
   356→]
   357→

    24→def _summary_similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    25→    left = normalize_word_set(a)
    26→    right = normalize_word_set(b)
    27→    if not left or not right:
    28→        return 0.0
    29→    overlap = len(left & right)
    30→    union = len(left | right)
    31→    return float(overlap) / float(union) if union else 0.0
    32→
    33→
    34→def _parse_holistic_identifier(finding_id: str) -> str:
    35→    parts = [part for part in str(finding_id).split("::") if part]
    36→    if len(parts) < 2:
    37→        return ""
    38→    candidate = parts[-2].strip()
    39→    if not candidate or candidate in {"holistic", "changed", "stale", "unreviewed"}:
    40→        return ""
    41→    return candidate
    42→
    43→
    44→def _related_files_set(finding: dict) -> set[str]:
    45→    related = finding.get("detail", {}).get("related_files", [])
    46→    if not isinstance(related, list):
    47→        return set()
    48→    return {str(path).strip() for path in related if str(path).strip()}

    17→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    18→class ResolvedEntity:
    19→    """Classifies what the user's show pattern refers to."""
    20→
    21→    kind: str  # "dimension", "special_view", "file_or_pattern"
    22→    pattern: str  # Original user pattern
    23→    display_name: str  # Human-readable label

    27→
    28→def _resolve_special_view(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    29→    if lowered not in ("concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"):
    30→        return None
    31→    return ResolvedEntity(
    32→        kind="special_view",
    33→        pattern=pattern,
    34→        display_name=pattern,
    35→    )
    36→
    37→
    38→def _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    39→    lookup = _build_dimension_lookup()
    40→    detectors = lookup.get(lowered) or lookup.get(pattern.lower())
    41→    if not detectors:
    42→        return None
    43→    dim_display = pattern
    44→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
    45→        dim_lowered = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    46→        if dim.name.lower() == lowered or dim_lowered == lowered:
    47→            dim_display = dim.name
    48→            break
    49→    return ResolvedEntity(
    50→        kind="dimension",
    51→        pattern=pattern,
    52→        display_name=dim_display,
    53→        detectors=tuple(detectors),
    54→        is_subjective=False,
    55→    )

    57→
    58→def _resolve_subjective_dimension(
    59→    pattern: str,
    60→    lowered: str,

    62→) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    63→    display_name = scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.get(lowered)
    64→    if not display_name:

    66→            if key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:

    69→    if not display_name:

    84→def resolve_entity(pattern: str, state: dict) -> ResolvedEntity:
    85→    """Classify a user pattern as a dimension, special view, or passthrough.
    86→
    87→    Resolution priority:
    88→    1. Special views: "concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"
    89→    2. Mechanical dimension name (from DIMENSIONS)
    90→    3. Subjective dimension name (from DISPLAY_NAMES / dimension_scores)
    91→    4. Everything else: file_or_pattern passthrough
    92→    """
    93→    lowered = pattern.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
    94→
    95→    # 1. Special views
    96→    special_view = _resolve_special_view(pattern, lowered)
    97→    if special_view is not None:
    98→        return special_view
    99→
   100→    # 2. Mechanical dimension (via DIMENSIONS list)
   101→    mechanical = _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern, lowered)
   102→    if mechanical is not None:
   103→        return mechanical
   104→
   105→    # 3. Subjective dimension (via DISPLAY_NAMES or dimension_scores)
   106→    subjective = _resolve_subjective_dimension(pattern, lowered, state)
   107→    if subjective is not None:

   109→
   110→    # 4. Everything else
   111→    return ResolvedEntity(

   115→    )

   118→def _build_dimension_lookup() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   119→    """Build a map from dimension name/key (lowered) to detector names."""
   120→    lookup: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   121→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   122→        detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   123→        lookup[dim.name.lower()] = detectors
   124→        # Also index by underscore key: "file_health" -> detectors
   125→        key = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   126→        if key not in lookup:
   127→            lookup[key] = detectors
   128→    # Also add DISPLAY_NAMES reverse lookup (e.g. "abstraction_fit" -> "Abstraction Fit")
   129→    for key, display in scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   130→        normalized_key = key.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   131→        normalized_display = display.lower()
   132→        # Find which dimension this belongs to via get_dimension_for_detector or direct name match
   133→        for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   134→            dim_lower = dim.name.lower()
   135→            if normalized_display == dim_lower or normalized_key == dim_lower.replace(" ", "_"):
   136→                detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   137→                if normalized_key not in lookup:
   138→                    lookup[normalized_key] = detectors
   139→                if normalized_display not in lookup:
   140→                    lookup[normalized_display] = detectors
   141→    return lookup
   142→
   143→
   144→def _lookup_dimension_score(
   145→    state: dict, display_name: str,
   146→) -> tuple[dict, str]:
   147→    """Find dimension_scores entry with case-insensitive fallback.
   148→
   149→    Returns (dim_data_dict, resolved_display_name).
   150→    """
   151→    lowered = display_name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   152→    dim_data = (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).get(display_name, {})
   153→    if not dim_data:
   154→        for ds_key, ds_val in (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).items():
   155→            if ds_key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:
   156→                dim_data = ds_val
   157→                display_name = ds_key
   158→                break
   159→    return dim_data, display_name
   160→

   163→    """Return a compact list of detector names for the help message."""
   164→    names = getattr(registry_mod, "DISPLAY_ORDER", [])
   165→    if names:
   166→        return ", ".join(names[:10]) + (", ..." if len(names) > 10 else "")
   167→    return "smells, structural, security, review, ..."
   168→
   169→
   170→def resolve_show_scope(args) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str, str | None]:
   171→    """Resolve scope/pattern/status for a show invocation."""
   172→    chronic = getattr(args, "chronic", False)
   173→    pattern = args.pattern
   174→    status_filter = "open" if chronic else getattr(args, "status", "open")
   175→    if chronic:
   176→        scope = pattern
   177→        pattern = pattern or "<chronic>"
   178→        return True, pattern, status_filter, scope
   179→    if not pattern:

   183→                "yellow",
   184→            )
   185→        )
   186→        return False, None, status_filter, ""
   187→    return True, pattern, status_filter, pattern

   198→    queue = build_work_queue(

   205→            include_subjective=False,
   206→            chronic=chronic,
   207→            no_tier_fallback=True,
   208→        ),

   210→    return [item for item in queue.get("items", []) if item.get("kind") == "finding"]

   218→    surfaced_matches, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(

   223→    return (

    28→
    29→def is_server_only_path(path: str) -> bool:
    30→    """Best-effort classification for server-only source paths."""
    31→    if not path:
    32→        return False
    33→    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/")
    34→    prefixed = normalized if normalized.startswith("/") else f"/{normalized}"
    35→    return any(hint in prefixed for hint in SERVER_ONLY_PATH_HINTS)
    36→

1→"""Flat directory detection — directories with too many source files."""
     2→
     3→import logging
     4→from collections import Counter
     5→from pathlib import Path
     6→
     7→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
     8→
     9→from desloppify.core.file_paths import resolve_scan_file
    10→
    11→THIN_WRAPPER_NAMES = frozenset(
    12→    {
    13→        "components",
    14→        "hooks",
    15→        "utils",
    16→        "services",
    17→        "state",
    18→        "contexts",

    20→        "types",
