   714→+    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   715→+    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   716→+    if last_completed:
   717→+        recent_completed = [
   718→+            c for c in all_completed
   719→+            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   720→+        ]
   721→+    else:
   722→+        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
   723→+
   724→+    return SynthesisInput(
   725→+        open_findings=open_review,
   726→+        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   727→+        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   728→+        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   729→+        new_since_last=new_since,
   730→+        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   731→+        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   732→+        synthesis_version=version,
   733→+        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
   734→+        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   735→+    )
   736→+
   737→+
   738→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   739→+# Prompt construction
   740→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   741→+
   742→+_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   743→+You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   744→+a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   745→+
   746→+Your plan should:
   747→+- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   748→+- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   749→+- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   750→+- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   751→+- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   752→+- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   753→+- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   754→+
   755→+Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   756→+
   757→+Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   758→+- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   759→+- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   760→+- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   761→+- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   762→+- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   763→+- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   764→+- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   765→+- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   766→+- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   767→+
   768→+Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   769→+will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   770→+removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   771→+
   772→+Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   773→+{
   774→+  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   775→+  "epics": [
   776→+    {
   777→+      "name": "slug-name",
   778→+      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   779→+      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   780→+      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   781→+      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   782→+      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   783→+      "agent_safe": true,
   784→+      "dependency_order": 1,
   785→+      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   786→+      "status": "pending"
   787→+    }
   788→+  ],
   789→+  "dismissed_findings": [
   790→+    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   791→+  ],
   792→+  "contradiction_notes": [
   793→+    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   794→+  ],
   795→+  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   796→+}
   797→+"""
   798→+
   799→+
   800→+def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
   801→+    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   802→+    parts: list[str] = []
   803→+
   804→+    # Section: existing epics
   805→+    if si.existing_epics:
   806→+        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   807→+        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   808→+            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   809→+            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   810→+            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   811→+            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   812→+            parts.append(
   813→+                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   814→+                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   815→+                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   816→+            )
   817→+        parts.append("")
   818→+
   819→+    # Section: what changed
   820→+    if si.new_since_last:
   821→+        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   822→+        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   823→+            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   824→+            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   825→+        parts.append("")
   826→+
   827→+    if si.resolved_since_last:
   828→+        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   829→+        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   830→+            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   831→+        parts.append("")
   832→+
   833→+    # Section: all open review findings
   834→+    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   835→+    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   836→+        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   837→+        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   838→+        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   839→+        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   840→+        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   841→+        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   842→+        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   843→+        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   844→+        if dimension:
   845→+            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   846→+        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   847→+        if suggestion:
   848→+            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   849→+    parts.append("")
   850→+
   851→+    # Section: dimension scores for context
   852→+    if si.dimension_scores:
   853→+        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   854→+        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   855→+            if isinstance(data, dict):
   856→+                score = data.get("score", "?")
   857→+                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   858→+                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   859→+                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   860→+        parts.append("")
   861→+
   862→+    # Section: previously dismissed
   863→+    if si.previously_dismissed:
   864→+        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   865→+        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   866→+        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   867→+            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   868→+        parts.append("")
   869→+
   870→+    return "\n".join(parts)
   871→+
   872→+
   873→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   874→+# Result parsing
   875→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   876→+
   877→+def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
   878→+    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
   879→+
   880→+    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   881→+    """
   882→+    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   883→+
   884→+    epics: list[dict] = []
   885→+    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   886→+        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   887→+            continue
   888→+        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   889→+        if not name:
   890→+            continue
   891→+        # Validate direction
   892→+        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   893→+        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   894→+            direction = "simplify"
   895→+        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   896→+        finding_ids = [
   897→+            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   898→+            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   899→+        ]
   900→+        dismissed = [
   901→+            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   902→+            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   903→+        ]
   904→+        action_steps = [
   905→+            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   906→+            if isinstance(s, str)
   907→+        ]
   908→+
   909→+        epics.append({
   910→+            "name": name,
   911→+            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   912→+            "direction": direction,
   913→+            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   914→+            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   915→+            "dismissed": dismissed,
   916→+            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   917→+            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   918→+            "action_steps": action_steps,
   919→+            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   920→+        })
   921→+
   922→+    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   923→+    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   924→+        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   925→+            continue
   926→+        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   927→+        if fid in valid_ids:
   928→+            dismissed_findings.append(
   929→+                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   930→+            )
   931→+
   932→+    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   933→+    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   934→+        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   935→+            continue
   936→+        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   937→+            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   938→+            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   939→+            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   940→+        ))
   941→+
   942→+    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   943→+
   944→+    return SynthesisResult(
   945→+        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   946→+        epics=epics,
   947→+        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   948→+        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   949→+        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   950→+    )
   951→+
   952→+
   953→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   954→+# Plan mutation
   955→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   956→+
   957→+def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
   958→+    plan: PlanModel,
   959→+    state: StateModel,
   960→+    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
   961→+    *,
   962→+    trigger: str = "manual",
   963→+) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   964→+    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   965→+
   966→+    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   967→+    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   968→+    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   969→+    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   970→+    """
   971→+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   972→+    now = utc_now()
   973→+    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   974→+    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   975→+
   976→+    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   977→+    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   978→+    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   979→+    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   980→+    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   981→+    result.synthesis_version = version
   982→+
   983→+    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
   984→+    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   985→+        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   986→+        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   987→+
   988→+        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   989→+        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   990→+            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
   991→+            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   992→+            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   993→+            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   994→+            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   995→+            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   996→+            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   997→+            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   998→+            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   999→+            existing["updated_at"] = now
  1000→+            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
  1001→+            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
  1002→+            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
  1003→+            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
  1004→+                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
  1005→+            result.epics_updated += 1
  1006→+        else:
  1007→+            # Create new synthesis-cluster
  1008→+            cluster: Cluster = {
  1009→+                "name": epic_name,
  1010→+                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
  1011→+                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
  1012→+                "auto": True,
  1013→+                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
  1014→+                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
  1015→+                "user_modified": False,
  1016→+                "created_at": now,
  1017→+                "updated_at": now,
  1018→+                # Epic fields
  1019→+                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
  1020→+                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
  1021→+                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
  1022→+                "supersedes": [],
  1023→+                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
  1024→+                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
  1025→+                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
  1026→+                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
  1027→+                "source_clusters": [],
  1028→+                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
  1029→+                "synthesis_version": version,
  1030→+            }
  1031→+            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
  1032→+            result.epics_created += 1
  1033→+
  1034→+    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
  1035→+    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
  1036→+    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
  1037→+        fid = df.finding_id
  1038→+        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
  1039→+        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
  1040→+        if fid in order:
  1041→+            order.remove(fid)
  1042→+        skipped[fid] = {
  1043→+            "finding_id": fid,
  1044→+            "kind": "synthesized_out",
  1045→+            "reason": df.reason,
  1046→+            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
  1047→+            "attestation": None,
  1048→+            "created_at": now,
  1049→+            "review_after": None,
  1050→+            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
  1051→+        }
  1052→+        result.findings_dismissed += 1
  1053→+
  1054→+    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
  1055→+    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
  1056→+        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
  1057→+            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
  1058→+                order.remove(fid)
  1059→+                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
  1060→+                skipped[fid] = {
  1061→+                    "finding_id": fid,
  1062→+                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
  1063→+                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
  1064→+                    "note": None,
  1065→+                    "attestation": None,
  1066→+                    "created_at": now,
  1067→+                    "review_after": None,
  1068→+                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
  1069→+                }
  1070→+                result.findings_dismissed += 1
  1071→+
  1072→+    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
  1073→+    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
  1074→+    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
  1075→+    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
  1076→+        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
  1077→+            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
  1078→+                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
  1079→+                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
  1080→+
  1081→+    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
  1082→+    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
  1083→+    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
  1084→+    new_order: list[str] = []
  1085→+    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
  1086→+    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
  1087→+        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
  1088→+    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
  1089→+    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
  1090→+    order.clear()
  1091→+    order.extend(new_order)
  1092→+
  1093→+    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
  1094→+    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
  1095→+    open_review_ids = sorted(
  1096→+        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
  1097→+        if f.get("status") == "open"
  1098→+        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
  1099→+    )
  1100→+
  1101→+    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
  1102→+        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
  1103→+        "last_run": now,
  1104→+        "version": version,
  1105→+        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
  1106→+        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
  1107→+        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
  1108→+        "trigger": trigger,
  1109→+    }
  1110→+    plan["updated"] = now
  1111→+
  1112→+    return result
  1113→+
  1114→+
  1115→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1116→+# Top-level orchestrator
  1117→+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1118→+
  1119→+@dataclass
  1120→+class SynthesisDeps:
  1121→+    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
  1122→+
  1123→+    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
  1124→+
  1125→+
  1126→+def synthesize_epics(
  1127→+    plan: PlanModel,
  1128→+    state: StateModel,
  1129→+    *,
  1130→+    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
  1131→+    dry_run: bool = False,
  1132→+    trigger: str = "manual",
  1133→+) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
  1134→+    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
  1135→+
  1136→+    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
  1137→+    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
  1138→+
  1139→+    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
  1140→+    """
  1141→+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
  1142→+    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
  1143→+
  1144→+    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
  1145→+    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
  1146→+
  1147→+    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
  1148→+        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
  1149→+        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
  1150→+        return result
  1151→+
  1152→+    # Call LLM
  1153→+    try:
  1154→+        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
  1155→+        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
  1156→+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
  1157→+        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
  1158→+        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
  1159→+        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
  1160→+        return result
  1161→+
  1162→+    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
  1163→+    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
  1164→+
  1165→+
  1166→+__all__ = [
  1167→+    "DismissedFinding",
  1168→+    "FINDING_ID_RE",
  1169→+    "SynthesisDeps",
  1170→+    "SynthesisInput",
  1171→+    "SynthesisMutationResult",
  1172→+    "SynthesisResult",
  1173→+    "apply_synthesis_to_plan",
  1174→+    "build_synthesis_prompt",
  1175→+    "collect_synthesis_input",
  1176→+    "detect_recurring_patterns",
  1177→+    "extract_finding_citations",
  1178→+    "last_real_review_timestamp",
  1179→+    "parse_synthesis_result",
  1180→+    "synthesize_epics",
  1181→+]

  1667→+
  1668→+def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
  1669→+    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
  1670→+
  1671→+    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
  1672→+    """
  1673→+    findings = state.get("findings", {})
  1674→+    review_ids = sorted(
  1675→+        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
  1676→+        if f.get("status") == "open"
  1677→+        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
  1678→+    )
  1679→+    if not review_ids:
  1680→+        return ""
  1681→+    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
  1682→+
  1683→+
  1684→+@dataclass
  1685→+class SynthesisSyncResult:
  1686→+    """What changed during a synthesis sync."""
  1687→+
  1688→+    injected: bool = False
  1689→+    pruned: bool = False
  1690→+
  1691→+    @property
  1692→+    def changes(self) -> int:
  1693→+        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
  1694→+
  1695→+
  1696→+def sync_synthesis_needed(
  1697→+    plan: PlanModel,
  1698→+    state: StateModel,
  1699→+) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
  1700→+    """Inject ``synthesis::pending`` at front of queue when review findings change.
  1701→+
  1702→+    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion (``_apply_completion``) removes it.
  1703→+    """
  1704→+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
  1705→+    result = SynthesisSyncResult()
  1706→+    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
  1707→+    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
  1708→+    already_present = SYNTHESIS_ID in order
  1709→+
  1710→+    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
  1711→+    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
  1712→+
  1713→+    # If hash changed and not already present, inject at front
  1714→+    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
  1715→+        order.insert(0, SYNTHESIS_ID)
  1716→+        result.injected = True
  1717→+
  1718→+    # Never auto-prune: synthesis::pending is only removed by explicit completion
  1719→+
  1720→+    return result

+
+def _resolve_plan_file(path: Path | None) -> Path:
+    return path if path is not None else PLAN_FILE

+
+def _plan_file_for_state(state_file: Path | None) -> Path | None:
+    if state_file is None:
+        return None
+    return plan_path_for_state(state_file)
+
+
+def _snapshot_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return None
+    return path.read_text()
+
+
+def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:
+    if snapshot is None:
+        try:
+            path.unlink()
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            return
+        return
+    safe_write_text(path, snapshot)
+
+
+def _save_plan_state_transactional(
+    *,
+    plan: dict,
+    plan_path: Path | None,
+    state_data: dict,
+    state_path_value: Path | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Persist plan+state together; rollback both files on partial write failure."""
+    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)
+    effective_state_path = _resolve_state_file(state_path_value)
+    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)
+    state_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_state_path)
+
+    try:
+        state_mod.save_state(state_data, effective_state_path)
+        save_plan(plan, effective_plan_path)
+    except Exception:
+        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_state_path, state_snapshot)
+        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_plan_path, plan_snapshot)
+        raise

  1872→+"""Tests for cross-file smells, string filtering helpers, and output structure."""
  1873→+
  1874→+import textwrap
  1875→+from pathlib import Path
  1876→+
  1877→+from desloppify.languages.python.detectors import smells as smells_mod
  1878→+from desloppify.languages.python.detectors.smells import detect_smells
  1879→+
  1880→+# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1881→+
  1882→+
  1883→+def _write_py(tmp_path: Path, code: str, filename: str = "test_mod.py") -> Path:
  1884→+    """Write a Python file and return the directory containing it."""
  1885→+    f = tmp_path / filename
  1886→+    f.write_text(textwrap.dedent(code))
  1887→+    return tmp_path
  1888→+
  1889→+
  1890→+def _smell_ids(entries: list[dict]) -> set[str]:
  1891→+    """Extract the set of smell IDs from detect_smells output."""
  1892→+    return {e["id"] for e in entries}
  1893→+
  1894→+
  1895→+def _find_smell(entries: list[dict], smell_id: str) -> dict | None:
  1896→+    """Find a specific smell entry by ID."""
  1897→+    for e in entries:
  1898→+        if e["id"] == smell_id:
  1899→+            return e
  1900→+    return None
  1901→+

  1912→+            'eval("real")',
  1913→+        ]
  1914→+        string_lines = smells_mod._build_string_line_set(lines)
  1915→+        assert 1 in string_lines  # inside triple-quote
  1916→+        assert 3 not in string_lines  # outside triple-quote
  1917→+
  1918→+    def test_same_line_triple_quote(self):
  1919→+        lines = ['x = """hello"""', 'eval("real")']
  1920→+        string_lines = smells_mod._build_string_line_set(lines)
  1921→+        assert 0 not in string_lines  # closed on same line
  1922→+        assert 1 not in string_lines

  2311→+
  2312→+    # Find the first opening brace after the match
  2313→+    start = match.end()

  2317→+

  2323→+            depth += 1
  2324→+        elif ch == "}":
  2325→+            depth -= 1
  2326→+            if depth == 0:
  2327→+                return content[brace_pos : i + 1]
  2328→+    return None

  2583→+"""String-aware TypeScript character scanner."""
  2584→+
  2585→+from __future__ import annotations
  2586→+
  2587→+from collections.abc import Generator
  2588→+
  2589→+
  2590→+def scan_code(
  2591→+    text: str, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None
  2592→+) -> Generator[tuple[int, str, bool], None, None]:
  2593→+    """Yield ``(index, char, in_string)`` tuples while handling escapes."""
  2594→+    i = start
  2595→+    limit = end if end is not None else len(text)
  2596→+    in_str = None
  2597→+    while i < limit:
  2598→+        ch = text[i]
  2599→+        if in_str:
  2600→+            if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < limit:
  2601→+                yield (i, ch, True)
  2602→+                i += 1
  2603→+                yield (i, text[i], True)
  2604→+                i += 1
  2605→+                continue
  2606→+            if ch == in_str:
  2607→+                in_str = None
  2608→+            yield (i, ch, in_str is not None)
  2609→+        else:
  2610→+            if ch in ("'", '"', "`"):
  2611→+                in_str = ch
  2612→+                yield (i, ch, True)
  2613→+            else:
  2614→+                yield (i, ch, False)
  2615→+        i += 1
  2616→+

@@ -0,0 +1,1028 @@
+"""Handler for ``plan synthesize`` subcommand.
+
+Implements a staged workflow: OBSERVE → REFLECT → ORGANIZE → COMMIT
+with a fast-track CONFIRM-EXISTING skip path.
+
+Stage gates validate **plan data enrichment**, not text reports:
+- OBSERVE: lightweight — write an analysis of themes/root causes (100 char min)
+- REFLECT: compare current findings against completed work (recurring patterns)
+- ORGANIZE: structural — each manual cluster must have description + action_steps
+- COMMIT: strategy must be substantive (200 char min) or "same"
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections import defaultdict
+
+from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.runtime import command_runtime
+from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.state import require_completed_scan
+from desloppify.app.commands.plan.synthesis_playbook import (
+    SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
+    SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS,
+    SYNTH_CMD_CLUSTER_ADD,
+    SYNTH_CMD_CLUSTER_CREATE,
+    SYNTH_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH_COMPACT,
+    SYNTH_CMD_CLUSTER_STEPS,
+    SYNTH_CMD_COMPLETE_VERBOSE,
+    SYNTH_CMD_CONFIRM_EXISTING,
+    SYNTH_CMD_OBSERVE,
+    SYNTH_CMD_ORGANIZE,
+    SYNTH_CMD_REFLECT,
+)
+from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
+from desloppify.engine._plan.epic_synthesis import (
+    build_synthesis_prompt,
+    collect_synthesis_input,
+    detect_recurring_patterns,
+    extract_finding_citations,
+)
+from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import review_finding_snapshot_hash
+from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
+from desloppify.engine.plan import SYNTHESIS_ID, load_plan, save_plan
+
+
+def _short_id(fid: str) -> str:
+    """Extract the 8-char hash suffix from a finding ID for compact display.
+
+    Finding IDs look like ``review::.::holistic::dim::identifier::abcdef12``.
+    Commands accept the hash suffix as a shorthand for the full ID.
+    """
+    if "::" in fid:
+        suffix = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1]
+        if len(suffix) >= 8:
+            return suffix[:8]
+    return fid
+
+
+def _synthesis_coverage(plan: dict) -> tuple[int, int, dict]:
+    """Return (organized, total, clusters) for synthesis progress."""
+    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
+    all_cluster_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for c in clusters.values():
+        all_cluster_ids.update(c.get("finding_ids", []))
+    queue_ids = [fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", []) if fid != SYNTHESIS_ID]
+    organized = sum(1 for fid in queue_ids if fid in all_cluster_ids)
+    return organized, len(queue_ids), clusters
+
+
+def _unenriched_clusters(plan: dict) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
+    """Return clusters with findings that are missing required enrichment.
+
+    Returns list of (cluster_name, list_of_missing_fields).
+    Only checks non-auto clusters (manual clusters the agent creates).
+    """
+    gaps: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
+    for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
+        if not cluster.get("finding_ids"):
+            continue
+        if cluster.get("auto"):
+            continue
+        missing: list[str] = []
+        if not cluster.get("description"):
+            missing.append("description")
+        if not cluster.get("action_steps"):
+            missing.append("action_steps")
+        if missing:
+            gaps.append((name, missing))
+    return gaps
+
+
+def _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan: dict) -> list[str]:
+    """Return names of non-auto clusters that have findings."""
+    return [
+        name for name, c in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
+        if c.get("finding_ids") and not c.get("auto")
+    ]
+
+
+def _print_stage_progress(stages: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> None:
+    """Print the 4-stage progress indicator."""
+    print(colorize("  Stages:", "dim"))
+    for stage_name, label in SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS:
+        if stage_name in stages:
+            print(colorize(f"    \u2713 {label}", "green"))
+        elif SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES[stage_name].issubset(stages):
+            print(colorize(f"    \u2192 {label} (current)", "yellow"))
+        else:
+            print(colorize(f"    \u25cb {label}", "dim"))
+
+    # Show enrichment gaps when in the organize stage
+    if plan and "reflect" in stages and "organize" not in stages:
+        gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
+        manual = _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan)
+        if not manual:
+            print(colorize("\n    No manual clusters yet. Create clusters and enrich them.", "yellow"))
+        elif gaps:
+            print(colorize(f"\n    {len(gaps)} cluster(s) need enrichment:", "yellow"))
+            for name, missing in gaps:
+                print(colorize(f"      {name}: missing {', '.join(missing)}", "yellow"))
+            print(colorize(
+                f"      Fix: {SYNTH_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH_COMPACT}",
+                "dim",
+            ))
+        else:
+            print(colorize(f"\n    All {len(manual)} manual cluster(s) enriched.", "green"))
+
+
+def _print_progress(plan: dict, open_findings: dict) -> None:
+    """Show cluster state and unclustered findings."""
+    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
+    # Only show clusters that actually have findings (hide empty/stale ones)
+    active_clusters = {
+        name: c for name, c in clusters.items()
+        if c.get("finding_ids")
+    }
+    if active_clusters:
+        print(colorize("\n  Current clusters:", "cyan"))
+        for name, cluster in active_clusters.items():
+            count = len(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
+            desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
+            steps = cluster.get("action_steps", [])
+            auto = cluster.get("auto", False)
+            tags: list[str] = []
+            if auto:
+                tags.append("auto")
+            if desc:
+                tags.append("desc")
+            else:
+                tags.append("no desc")
+            if steps:
+                tags.append(f"{len(steps)} steps")
+            else:
+                if not auto:
+                    tags.append("no steps")
+            tag_str = f" [{', '.join(tags)}]"
+            desc_str = f" \u2014 {desc}" if desc else ""
+            print(f"    {name}: {count} items{tag_str}{desc_str}")
+
+    all_clustered: set[str] = set()
+    for c in clusters.values():
+        all_clustered.update(c.get("finding_ids", []))
+    unclustered = [fid for fid in open_findings if fid not in all_clustered]
+    if unclustered:
+        print(colorize(f"\n  {len(unclustered)} findings not yet in a cluster:", "yellow"))
+        for fid in unclustered[:10]:
+            f = open_findings[fid]
+            dim = (f.get("detail", {}) or {}).get("dimension", "") if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else ""
+            short = _short_id(fid)
+            print(f"    [{short}] [{dim}] {f.get('summary', '')}")
+        if len(unclustered) > 10:
+            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(unclustered) - 10} more", "dim"))
+    elif open_findings:
+        organized, total, _ = _synthesis_coverage(plan)
+        print(colorize(f"\n  All {organized}/{total} findings are in clusters.", "green"))
+
+
+def _apply_completion(args: argparse.Namespace, plan: dict, strategy: str) -> None:
+    """Shared completion logic: update meta, remove synthesis::pending, save."""
+    organized, total, clusters = _synthesis_coverage(plan)
+
+    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
+    if SYNTHESIS_ID in order:
+        order.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
+
+    runtime = command_runtime(args)
+    state = runtime.state
+    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
+
+    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
+    meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
+    if strategy.strip().lower() != "same":
+        meta["strategy_summary"] = strategy
+    meta["trigger"] = "manual_synthesis"
+    meta["last_completed_at"] = utc_now()
+    meta["synthesis_stages"] = {}  # clear stages on completion
+    meta.pop("stage_refresh_required", None)
+    meta.pop("stage_snapshot_hash", None)
+
+    save_plan(plan)
+
+    cluster_count = len([c for c in clusters.values() if c.get("finding_ids")])
+    print(colorize(f"  Synthesis complete: {organized}/{total} findings in {cluster_count} cluster(s).", "green"))
+    effective_strategy = strategy if strategy.strip().lower() != "same" else meta.get("strategy_summary", "")
+    if effective_strategy:
+        print(colorize(f"  Strategy: {effective_strategy}", "cyan"))
+    print(colorize("  Run `desloppify next` to start implementation.", "green"))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Stage handlers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _cmd_stage_observe(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    """Record the OBSERVE stage: agent analyses themes and root causes.
+
+    No citation gate — the point is genuine analysis, not ID-stuffing.
+    Just requires a 100-char report describing what the agent observed.

+def normalize_review_import_mode(raw: str | None) -> ReviewImportMode:
+    """Normalize user/caller import mode text to one stable mode token."""
+    mode = (raw or "auto").strip().lower().replace("-", "_")
+    if mode not in _ALLOWED_MODES:
+        allowed = ", ".join(sorted(_ALLOWED_MODES))
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid review import mode '{raw}'; expected one of: {allowed}")
+    return mode  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+
+def _validate_mode_compatibility(
+    *,
+    mode: ReviewImportMode,
+    attested: bool,
+    manual: bool,
+) -> None:
+    if mode == "trusted_internal" and (attested or manual):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "import_mode=trusted_internal cannot be combined with attested/manual flags"
+        )
+    if mode == "attested_external" and manual:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "import_mode=attested_external cannot be combined with manual override flags"
+        )
+    if mode == "manual_override" and attested:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "import_mode=manual_override cannot be combined with attested external flags"
+        )
+
+
+def _apply_trusted_internal_defaults(
+    trusted_source: bool,
+    trusted_label: str | None,
+) -> tuple[bool, str, bool, bool]:
+    if not trusted_source:
+        trusted_source = True
+    if not isinstance(trusted_label, str) or not trusted_label.strip():
+        trusted_label = "trusted internal run-batches import"
+    return trusted_source, trusted_label, False, False
+
+
+def apply_review_import_mode(
+    *,
+    import_mode: str | None,
+    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
+    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
+    attested_external: bool,
+    manual_override: bool,
+) -> tuple[bool, str | None, bool, bool]:
+    """Apply a canonical import mode over legacy booleans without dropping compatibility."""
+    mode = normalize_review_import_mode(import_mode)
+    trusted_source = bool(trusted_assessment_source)
+    trusted_label = trusted_assessment_label
+    attested = bool(attested_external)
+    manual = bool(manual_override)
+
+    _validate_mode_compatibility(mode=mode, attested=attested, manual=manual)
+
+    if mode == "trusted_internal":
+        return _apply_trusted_internal_defaults(trusted_source, trusted_label)
+    if mode == "attested_external":
+        return trusted_source, trusted_label, True, False
+    if mode == "manual_override":
+        return trusted_source, trusted_label, False, True
+
+    return trusted_source, trusted_label, attested, manual
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ReviewImportMode",
+    "apply_review_import_mode",
+    "normalize_review_import_mode",
+]

+"""Shared review packet policy helpers.
+
+Both ``prepare.py`` and ``batch.py`` need the same config-redaction and
+batch-file-limit coercion.  Extracting them here prevents drift.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+DEFAULT_REVIEW_BATCH_MAX_FILES = 80
+
+
+def redacted_review_config(config: dict | None) -> dict:
+    """Return review packet config with target score removed for blind assessment."""
+    if not isinstance(config, dict):
+        return {}
+    return {key: value for key, value in config.items() if key != "target_strict_score"}
+
+
+def coerce_review_batch_file_limit(config: dict | None) -> int | None:
+    """Resolve per-batch review file cap from config (0/negative => unlimited)."""
+    raw = (config or {}).get("review_batch_max_files", DEFAULT_REVIEW_BATCH_MAX_FILES)
+    try:
+        value = int(raw)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return DEFAULT_REVIEW_BATCH_MAX_FILES
+    return value if value > 0 else None

+"""Centralized execution policy for review batch orchestration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (
+    coerce_non_negative_float as _coerce_non_negative_float,
+)
+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (
+    coerce_non_negative_int as _coerce_non_negative_int,
+)
+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (
+    coerce_positive_float as _coerce_positive_float,
+)
+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (
+    coerce_positive_int as _coerce_positive_int,
+)
+
+DEFAULT_BATCH_STALL_KILL_SECONDS = 120
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BatchRunPolicy:
+    """Resolved runtime knobs for `review --run-batches` execution."""
+
+    run_parallel: bool
+    max_parallel_batches: int
+    heartbeat_seconds: float
+    batch_timeout_seconds: int
+    batch_max_retries: int
+    batch_retry_backoff_seconds: float
+    stall_warning_seconds: int
+    stall_kill_seconds: int
+
+    def max_parallel_workers(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
+        if total_batches <= 0:
+            return 1
+        if self.run_parallel:
+            return min(total_batches, self.max_parallel_batches)
+        return 1
+
+    def worst_case_minutes(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
+        waves = math.ceil(total_batches / self.max_parallel_workers(total_batches))
+        return max(1, math.ceil((waves * self.batch_timeout_seconds) / 60))
+
+
+def resolve_batch_run_policy(args) -> BatchRunPolicy:
+    """Build one canonical policy object from CLI args."""
+    return BatchRunPolicy(
+        run_parallel=bool(getattr(args, "parallel", False)),
+        max_parallel_batches=_coerce_positive_int(
+            getattr(args, "max_parallel_batches", None),
+            default=3,
+            minimum=1,
+        ),
+        heartbeat_seconds=_coerce_positive_float(
+            getattr(args, "batch_heartbeat_seconds", None),
+            default=15.0,
+            minimum=0.1,
+        ),
+        batch_timeout_seconds=_coerce_positive_int(
+            getattr(args, "batch_timeout_seconds", None),
+            default=2 * 60 * 60,
+            minimum=1,
+        ),
+        batch_max_retries=_coerce_positive_int(
+            getattr(args, "batch_max_retries", None),
+            default=1,
+            minimum=0,
+        ),
+        batch_retry_backoff_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_float(
+            getattr(args, "batch_retry_backoff_seconds", None),
+            default=2.0,
+        ),
+        stall_warning_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_int(
+            getattr(args, "batch_stall_warning_seconds", None),
+            default=0,
+        ),
+        stall_kill_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_int(
+            getattr(args, "batch_stall_kill_seconds", None),
+            default=DEFAULT_BATCH_STALL_KILL_SECONDS,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["BatchRunPolicy", "resolve_batch_run_policy"]

+"""Runtime setup helpers for review command flows."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+from desloppify.core.file_paths import rel
+from desloppify.core.output import log
+from desloppify.engine.policy.zones import FileZoneMap
+from desloppify.languages import runtime as lang_runtime_mod
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from desloppify.languages._framework.base.types import LangConfig
+    from desloppify.languages._framework.runtime import LangRun
+
+
+def setup_lang(
+    lang: LangConfig,
+    path: Path,
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    make_lang_run_fn: Callable[[LangConfig], LangRun],
+    file_zone_map_cls: type[FileZoneMap],
+    rel_fn: Callable[[str], str],
+    log_fn: Callable[[str], None],
+) -> tuple[LangRun, list[str]]:
+    """Build LangRun with zone map + dep graph and return (run, files)."""
+    lang_run = make_lang_run_fn(lang)
+    files: list[str] = []
+
+    if lang_run.zone_rules and lang_run.file_finder:
+        files = lang_run.file_finder(path)
+        zone_overrides = config.get("zone_overrides") or None
+        lang_run.zone_map = file_zone_map_cls(
+            files, lang_run.zone_rules, rel_fn=rel_fn, overrides=zone_overrides
+        )
+
+    if lang_run.build_dep_graph and lang_run.dep_graph is None:
+        try:
+            lang_run.dep_graph = lang_run.build_dep_graph(path)
+        except (
+            OSError,
+            UnicodeDecodeError,
+            ValueError,
+            TypeError,
+            RuntimeError,
+        ) as exc:
+            log_fn(f"  dep graph unavailable for review context: {exc}")
+
+    return lang_run, files
+
+
+def setup_lang_concrete(lang: LangConfig, path: Path, config: dict) -> tuple[LangRun, list[str]]:
+    """Build LangRun with zone map + dep graph using concrete dependencies."""
+    return setup_lang(
+        lang,
+        path,
+        config,
+        make_lang_run_fn=lang_runtime_mod.make_lang_run,
+        file_zone_map_cls=FileZoneMap,
+        rel_fn=rel,
+        log_fn=log,
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["setup_lang", "setup_lang_concrete"]

1→"""Stable review import mode normalization for command entrypoints."""
     2→

     4→
     5→from typing import Literal
     6→
     7→ReviewImportMode = Literal[
     8→    "auto",

    13→
    14→_ALLOWED_MODES: set[str] = {
    15→    "auto",

    19→}
    20→
    21→
    22→def normalize_review_import_mode(raw: str | None) -> ReviewImportMode:
    23→    """Normalize user/caller import mode text to one stable mode token."""
    24→    mode = (raw or "auto").strip().lower().replace("-", "_")
    25→    if mode not in _ALLOWED_MODES:
    26→        allowed = ", ".join(sorted(_ALLOWED_MODES))
    27→        raise ValueError(f"invalid review import mode '{raw}'; expected one of: {allowed}")
    28→    return mode  # type: ignore[return-value]
    29→
    30→
    31→def _validate_mode_compatibility(
    32→    *,
    33→    mode: ReviewImportMode,
    34→    attested: bool,
    35→    manual: bool,
    36→) -> None:
    37→    if mode == "trusted_internal" and (attested or manual):
    38→        raise ValueError(
    39→            "import_mode=trusted_internal cannot be combined with attested/manual flags"
    40→        )
    41→    if mode == "attested_external" and manual:
    42→        raise ValueError(
    43→            "import_mode=attested_external cannot be combined with manual override flags"
    44→        )
    45→    if mode == "manual_override" and attested:
    46→        raise ValueError(
    47→            "import_mode=manual_override cannot be combined with attested external flags"
    48→        )
    49→
    50→
    51→def _apply_trusted_internal_defaults(
    52→    trusted_source: bool,
    53→    trusted_label: str | None,
    54→) -> tuple[bool, str, bool, bool]:
    55→    if not trusted_source:
    56→        trusted_source = True
    57→    if not isinstance(trusted_label, str) or not trusted_label.strip():
    58→        trusted_label = "trusted internal run-batches import"
    59→    return trusted_source, trusted_label, False, False
    60→
    61→
    62→def apply_review_import_mode(
    63→    *,
    64→    import_mode: str | None,
    65→    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
    66→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
    67→    attested_external: bool,
    68→    manual_override: bool,
    69→) -> tuple[bool, str | None, bool, bool]:
    70→    """Apply a canonical import mode over legacy booleans without dropping compatibility."""
    71→    mode = normalize_review_import_mode(import_mode)
    72→    trusted_source = bool(trusted_assessment_source)
    73→    trusted_label = trusted_assessment_label
    74→    attested = bool(attested_external)

    76→

    81→    if mode == "attested_external":

    83→    if mode == "manual_override":

    85→
    86→    return trusted_source, trusted_label, attested, manual

+"""Post-scan plan workflow nudge.
+
+Dependency-light module that only imports plan/queue helpers — avoids
+the import cycle that previously forced function-level imports in scan.py.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
+from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
+from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
+
+
+def print_plan_workflow_nudge(state: dict) -> None:
+    """Print a queue-count reminder when plan-start scores exist."""
+    try:
+        plan = load_plan()
+        if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
+            return
+        queue_total = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        return
+
+    if queue_total <= 0:
+        return
+    print(
+        colorize(
+            f"  Workflow: {queue_total} queue item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}."
+            " Score is frozen until the queue is clear — use `desloppify next` to begin.",
+            "dim",
+        )
+    )

This confirms a meaningful behavior change. The old logic: `supported_fixers is None or fixer in supported_fixers` -- when `supported_fixers` is None, ALL fixers are considered available. The new logic: `supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers` -- when `supported_fixers` is None, NO fixers are considered available. This is a significant semantic change.

    26→    """Resolved runtime knobs for `review --run-batches` execution."""
    27→
    28→    run_parallel: bool
    29→    max_parallel_batches: int
    30→    heartbeat_seconds: float
    31→    batch_timeout_seconds: int
    32→    batch_max_retries: int
    33→    batch_retry_backoff_seconds: float
    34→    stall_warning_seconds: int
    35→    stall_kill_seconds: int
    36→
    37→    def max_parallel_workers(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
    38→        if total_batches <= 0:
    39→            return 1
    40→        if self.run_parallel:
    41→            return min(total_batches, self.max_parallel_batches)
    42→        return 1
    43→
    44→    def worst_case_minutes(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
    45→        waves = math.ceil(total_batches / self.max_parallel_workers(total_batches))
    46→        return max(1, math.ceil((waves * self.batch_timeout_seconds) / 60))
    47→
    48→
    49→def resolve_batch_run_policy(args) -> BatchRunPolicy:
    50→    """Build one canonical policy object from CLI args."""
    51→    return BatchRunPolicy(

     2→
     3→Clusters review findings by root cause, dismisses false positives,
     4→resolves contradictions, and orders by dependency. The synthesis is incremental:
     5→it updates existing synthesis-clusters rather than recreating from scratch.

     8→from __future__ import annotations

    33→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    34→# Finding-ID citation extraction
    35→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    36→
    37→FINDING_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z_]+::[a-f0-9]{8,}")
    38→
    39→
    40→def extract_finding_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
    41→    """Extract finding IDs cited in free text.
    42→
    43→    Matches full finding IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
    44→    hex suffixes that correspond to a known finding.
    45→    """
    46→    cited: set[str] = set()
    47→    # Match full finding IDs
    48→    for match in FINDING_ID_RE.finditer(text):
    49→        candidate = match.group()
    50→        if candidate in valid_ids:
    51→            cited.add(candidate)
    52→    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
    53→    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
    54→        for valid_id in valid_ids:
    55→            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
    56→                cited.add(valid_id)
    57→                break
    58→    return cited
    59→
    60→
    61→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    62→# Completed-work helpers
    63→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    64→
    65→def last_real_review_timestamp(state: dict) -> str | None:
    66→    """ISO timestamp of most recent genuine review import (not manual override/scan reset)."""
    67→    REAL_MODES = {"holistic", "per_file", "trusted_internal", "attested_external"}
    68→    audit = state.get("assessment_import_audit", [])
    69→    if isinstance(audit, list):
    70→        for entry in reversed(audit):
    71→            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("mode") in REAL_MODES:
    72→                ts = entry.get("timestamp")
    73→                if ts:
    74→                    return str(ts)
    75→    holistic = (state.get("review_cache") or {}).get("holistic")
    76→    if isinstance(holistic, dict):
    77→        return holistic.get("reviewed_at")
    78→    return None
    79→
    80→
    81→def detect_recurring_patterns(
    82→    open_findings: dict[str, dict],
    83→    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict],
    84→) -> dict[str, dict]:
    85→    """Detect dimensions with both resolved AND current open findings.
    86→
    87→    Returns ``{dimension: {"open": [ids], "resolved": [ids]}}``.
    88→    A dimension with both resolved and open findings signals a potential
    89→    loop — similar issues recur after previous fixes.
    90→    """
    91→    def _dimension(f: dict) -> str:
    92→        detail = f.get("detail", {})
    93→        if isinstance(detail, dict):
    94→            return detail.get("dimension", "")
    95→        return ""
    96→
    97→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    98→    for fid, f in open_findings.items():
    99→        dim = _dimension(f)
   100→        if dim:
   101→            open_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
   102→
   103→    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   104→    for fid, f in resolved_findings.items():
   105→        dim = _dimension(f)
   106→        if dim:
   107→            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
   108→
   109→    recurring: dict[str, dict] = {}
   110→    for dim in set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim):
   111→        recurring[dim] = {
   112→            "open": open_by_dim[dim],
   113→            "resolved": resolved_by_dim[dim],
   114→        }
   115→    return recurring

   122→@dataclass

   125→
   126→    open_findings: dict[str, dict]       # id -> finding (review + concerns)
   127→    mechanical_findings: dict[str, dict]  # id -> finding (non-review, for context)

   135→    completed_clusters: list[dict]       # clusters completed since last synthesis
